Name: 404: Soul Not Found
Description: ERROR IN YOUR WAYS. 404: SOUL NOT FOUND is a highly-pigmented multichrome magnetic lacquer that shifts between teal, blue, and purple, and reveals a black base when magnetized. from the WELCOME TO PARADISE SET . wear + care: first photo’s look created using the round end of the magnetic wand this shade can look dramatically different depending on the magnetization method, lighting, or angle it’s viewed from no one photo will truly capture its full appearance. we recommend viewing all photos to see the full range

Name: A Doll's House
Description: NO ONE’S PLAYTHING. don’t ever let this soft rose hue distract you from the sharp, ferocious claws it continually costumes. it’s the perfect shade for covertly weaving your own searing masterpiece - one told in III riveting acts. far from a fluffy, frilly folly, this bud definitely has thorns. A DOLL’S HOUSE is a dusty rose creme lacquer. from the A TALE OF 5 LACQUERS SET .

Name: A Midsummer's Dream
Description: DREAM AWAY THE DAY. you’ve been hit by cupid’s arrow. fan the moonbeams from your sleeping eyes, as you coast through a romantic, rose-colored haze that’s shimmering with a blushing blue wink of midday magic. though this lacquer be but little, it is fierce, with an intoxicating iridescent sheen that’ll leave you utterly lovestruck. A MIDSUMMER’S DREAM is a sheer, iridescent pink lacquer filled with bright blue shimmer. note: this shade has an intentionally ethereal sheerness that helps give it a whimsical and delicate appearance.

Name: A Most Destructive Melody
Description: LIKE A BATTLE CRY IN A BOTTLE. will this be your swan song? from the most honest pockets of our souls comes the remnants of our rage, mashed into ultra-shifty bits to form a most briney multichrome ballad. with frequent keyshifts from a shimmering blue major to a piercing purple minor, there be not harmony here. A MOST DESTRUCTIVE MELODY is a multichrome shimmer lacquer that shifts between shades of blue and purple as it’s viewed from different angles. from the SONGS OF SIRENS SET .

Name: A Tale Of 5 Lacquers Set
Description: LET ME PAINT THE SCENE. it was the best of shades, it was the worst of indecision…or so the story goes. because each bookish creme in this v literary set instantly became a covetable classic across the galaxy. there were epic quests to uncover. drama to behold. + double entendres to unpack. + our MOONCAT protagonists could hardly decide which genre to sink their claws into first. the A TALE OF 5 LACQUERS SET includes five cremes: THE STRANGER , BEOWULF , KAFKAESQUE , FREUDIAN SLIP , and A DOLL’S HOUSE .

Name: Abandoned Boardwalks
Description: BREAK THE RULES. this unexpected aqua creme lacquer is reminiscent of summers spent sneaking around, feeling above it all. ABANDONED BOARDWALKS is a vibrant aqua creme lacquer. to protect your nails from possible staining from the rich pigments in this polish, we recommend starting your mani with our HARDCORE BASE COAT

Name: Abominable
Description: A CHILL-INDUCING RAREMADE REWARDS-EXCLUSIVE HUE. ABOMINABLE is a limited-edition blue RAREMADE lacquer filled with pink shimmer, ULTRA-fine holographic flakies, + micro holographic glitter. only available for reward redemption in THE MISFITS CLUB while supplies last. wear + care: what’s a RAREMADE lacquer? sometimes, a pigment batch arrives looking slightly different (in color, size, etc.) than what we approved, + can’t be used for an intended shade. RAREMADES reimagine these perfectly usable, but unintentionally unique, limited pigment batches into something truly one-of-a-kind. note: only 1 bottle of this lacquer can be redeemed per order.

Name: Access Denied
Description: YOU SHALL NOT PASS. the authentication key you’ve entered is invalid. infinite strings of shimmering green code will now surround you, carefully encrypting the vast, black, uncharted expanse you seek so desperately to wander. ACCESS DENIED is a black lacquer filled with green shimmer. from the GLITCH IN THE MATRIX collection.

Name: Acidic
Description: FEED YOUR HEAD. open the doors of perception. sink your fangs into a tangy tangerine creme that’s equal parts sweet and sour. ACIDIC is a tangerine creme lacquer. from the TECHNICOLOR DREAMS collection.

Name: Acidwashed
Description: HANG LOOSE. surf’s up. ditch your bellbottoms and sink your claws into this totally tubular shade of aqua lacquer that’s twinkling with iridescent pink flakies reminiscent of sea salt and froths of sparkling seafoam tones. it’s always high tide here. ACIDWASHED is an aqua jelly lacquer filled with green and pink iridescent flakies. its buildable formula can be layered to your liking, for either a semi-sheer or more opaque look. from the KALEIDOSCOPE HAZE SET .

Name: After The Rain
Description: EMBRACE THE DOWNPOUR. like a deluge of periwinkle precipitation still sprinkling down against the warm afterglow of a humid sky mid-moonrise, or the bold jolt of a poppy-like post-shower flower bursting through the cracks of a glistening roadside, this glimmering shade is like a claw reset. with its dewy, semi-sheer peri base, blooming with a defiant blaze of electrifying orange shimmer, it’ll help cleanse your claws of any lingering gloom. AFTER THE RAIN is a semi-sheer periwinkle lacquer filled with orange shimmer. from the FALLEN SET . note: this shade has an intentionally ethereal sheerness, but can be layered to your liking over a coat of our GETTING EVEN NAIL PRIMER for a more opaque look.

Name: Alien Invasion
Description: THEY COME AT NIGHT. extraterrestrial beings moving stealthily through the shadows. under the cover of darkness, the golden shift in their emerald forms is more carefully concealed. but the unshakeable feeling... the acute sense that you’re never actually alone... it’s always lingering. as they creep closer and closer and closer. an ever-encroaching swarm. ALIEN INVASION is a multichrome lacquer that shifts between shades of emerald and gold as it’s viewed from different angles.

Name: All Bark
Description: DEFINITELY WORTH FETCHING. ALL BARK is a warm ash brown creme lacquer. From the SUNDOG SET .

Name: Am I Everything You Fear?
Description: AM I A FIGMENT OF YOUR NIGHTMARES? am i the “monster” you hoped for? does my ever-shifting temperament satiate your taste for doom? do my perma-shifts from teal-to-pink-to-orange feed your festering phobias? or is it the surprisingly sincere warmth of my glimmering blood-rushed pink-flush that’s filled you with a disquieting dread? and has the twinkling of my holo-dusted scale-encrusted fin, extended earnestly as a helping hand, simply highlighted an unshakable realization - that perhaps you are the enemy you dread… AM I EVERYTHING YOU FEAR? ​​is a dusty deep teal lacquer filled with color-shifting pink-to-orange-to-green shimmer and micro holographic glitter. from the SONGS OF SIRENS SET .

Name: Antifragile
Description: PRESSURE BREEDS DIAMONDS. birthed from chaos. strengthened by a lifetime of volatility. convex, complex, and beyond resilient. get close enough and its cold, indigo visage will begin to slowly melt away, revealing the entire holographic spectrum of its beautifully complex being. ANTIFRAGILE is an indigo linear holographic lacquer. from the HEAVY IS THE CROWN collection. note: holographic lacquers look best in the sunlight or under a direct light, where they reveal their full rainbow effect. in the shade or overcast conditions, the effect will be more muted (but still mesmerizing).

Name: Antivenom
Description: EVIL DOESN’T STAND A CHANCE. we’ve bottled the perfect antidote. summon this mystical white-to-green lacquer for an immediate claw cleanse. just don’t mistake this bewitching hex for something wholly divine. with a sinister slither of green shimmer and a pang of holo glitter, this sufficiently soothing hue still manages to pack a delightfully ferocious bite. ANTIVENOM is a duochrome lacquer filled with holographic glitter that shifts between shades of soft white and green. from the MEDUSA UNLEASHED SET .

Name: Aphrodisiac
Description: CATCH SOME FEELS. straight from the heavens, it’s a universally swoon-worthy shade. the type of beauty that’s been known to start a war. uncap this romance-inducing tincture and you’ll quickly feel something new...confusing…exciting, as this sultry sheer pink lacquer comes alive with an electrifying wave of intense purple shimmer and a demure dash of micro holo glitter. APHRODISIAC is a sheer pink lacquer filled with purple shimmer and micro holographic glitter that looks most divine in the sun. from the GODDESS COMPLEX SET . note: this shade has an intentionally ethereal sheerness, but can be layered to your liking over a coat of our GETTING EVEN NAIL PRIMER for a more opaque look. this is pink piglet 3.0.

Name: Apollo
Description: it’s one small step for man, one giant leap for mooncats everywhere. let the subtle mystery of this midnight blue magnetic lacquer transfix you. it harkens to the wanderers, the seekers, the eternal adventurers, with a curious scattering of glitter that never fully settles, constantly shifting and shining in the light. dazzling like a million undiscovered moons. APOLLO is a navy magnetic lacquer filled with holographic glitter that reveals a silver-to-purple stripe. note: all orders with magnetic lacquers include one free magnetic wand .

Name: Apparition
Description: PREPARE TO BE HAUNTED. no, you’re not seeing things. there’s definitely something –a presence– emerging from the magnetized darkness. a ghastly silver silhouette floating listlessly against the shimmering black twilight… meticulously following your every movement. slowly pulling you in. APPARITION is a black magnetic lacquer with a subtle blue shimmer that reveals a silver magnetic stripe. this is OPTIC 2.0. note: all orders with magnetic lacquers include one free magnetic wand . WARNING: this product can expose you to chemicals including nickel, which is known to the state of CALIFORNIA to cause cancer. for more information visit www.p65warnings.ca.gov

Name: Artemis' Deathkiss
Description: THE ETERNAL NIGHT. on the hunt for something extra celestial? you’ve been struck by a bit of divine luck. an entrancing homage to the eponymous lunar huntress, this mystical tincture features a dusky gray-purple base that’s seemingly moonlit by an intense glow of purple shimmer and a dash of micro holo glitter that twinkles like stars in the night sky. ARTEMIS’ DEATHKISS is a gray-purple lacquer filled with purple shimmer and micro holographic glitter that looks most divine in the sun. from the GODDESS COMPLEX SET .

Name: Atomica
Description: A HAUNTINGLY BEAUTIFUL SIGHT. ATOMICA is a light moss green metallic lacquer. from the BAND OF MISFITS II SET - and available for a limited time.

Name: Aura
Description: IT’S GIVING…✦ENLIGHTENED✦. this one is a whole vibe. emitting shimmering glints of blue and purple energy, this transformative topper has been known to have a lasting effect on every lacquer it meets. AURA is an iridescent shimmer topper that shifts between shades of blue and purple.

Name: Band Of Misfits II Set
Description: PROTOTYPES ONCE MISFIT ARE NOW BROUGHT TO LIFE. the BAND OF MISFITS II SET includes 4 nail lacquers. 3 special effect shades + 1 matte topper: ATOMICA , NIGHTBREAK , THE FIREBIRD , and SUGAR AND SPICE TOPPER . all available for a limited time.

Name: Banished Prince
Description: UNLEASH THE POWER OF A HUNDRED SUNS. BANISHED PRINCE is a red thermal lacquer filled with color-shifting iridescent orange-to-yellow-to-green flakies, that transitions from a shade of dark red when cold to bright red when warm. from our AVATAR: THE LAST AIRBENDER collaboration collection - and only available for a limited time. wear + care: features a limited-edition firebending bottle design with a special gold cap + a limited-edition FIRE NATION carton thermal effects may vary based on body chemistry, temperature, + climate formula tends to be thicker due to the special pigments used. when needed, simply add a few drops of LACQUER REVITALIZER , to revive its consistency. use a base coat + SPEED DEMON TOP COAT to prevent chipping + extend wear note: this item only ships to the US and CANADA. © 2025 Viacom International Inc.

Name: Banquet of Breadcrumbs
Description: CHAPTER V: DISILLUSIONS OF GRANDEUR. somewhere the figurative feast suddenly seized. but follow the trail of glittering yellow-green grains…hanging onto each and every empty morsel…hoping it leads somewhere more sustaining. savoring every shimmering chromey bit, as you shape-shift it into a hue anew. for every time you grow wary and withdrawn from the public displays of detachment, it’ll only grow greener with envy…and the road ahead, will be, yet again, gilded with fresh granules of glittering yellow-green all the way back to you. BANQUET OF BREADCRUMBS is a bright yellow-green lacquer filled with chromey yellow-green shimmer. from the BAROQUEN SET .

Name: Bare Necessities Set
Description: TRUST US: THESE 3 ARE AN ACTUAL ✦ NEED ✦. consider this trio wearable art’s BFFs. bc these three must-haves will always have your claws’ back. get em to team up and they’ll put a powerful hex on chips, breaks, and just general bad vibes. your mission? simple. just adhere to this easy routine: start every mani with a smoothing coat of our long-lasting nail primer, end it with a glossy layer of our tough-as-nails, quick-drying top coat, and make a habit out of regularly applying our vitamin-rich nail and cuticle oil all throughout the day. your v happy future claws and paws can thank us later. the BARE NECESSITIES SET includes our GETTING EVEN NAIL PRIMER , SPEED DEMON TOP COAT , + NAIL ELIXIR .

Name: Beowulf
Description: BEHOLD! A KNIGHT IN SHINING EMERALD. in the days of yore, amid deeds of valor, one most honorable green lacquer emerged victorious. sharpen your claws and help them stand guard in this suitably valiant coat of lacquered armor. one truly worthy of all of your most epic quests. grendel’s paws could never. BEOWULF is an emerald green creme lacquer. from the A TALE OF 5 LACQUERS SET .

Name: Bermuda Triangle
Description: GET INEXPLICABLY LOST. all who enter this stormy purple haze are subject to get lost in its captivating beauty. should you choose to brave these mysterious purple waters nonetheless, don’t be surprised as your claws gradually begin to disappear behind a sudden, disorienting fog of cold, glimmering green shimmer, glowing green flakies, and hypnotizing pops of super micro holo glitter. BERMUDA TRIANGLE is a purple jelly lacquer filled with green iridescent flakies and super micro holographic glitter. from the MERMAID TALES SET .

Name: Best Bud
Description: LET THE GOOD TIMES ROLL. ready for a pick-me-up? ppl, let me tell you about my best friend. this real down-to-earth lime lacquer always knows how to lift me up with a real w h o o o o a-inducing slow dance through totally chill turquoise and chartreuse shades. BEST BUD is a lime green jelly lacquer filled with turquoise and chartreuse iridescent flakies. its buildable formula can be layered to your liking, for either a semi-sheer or more opaque look. from the KALEIDOSCOPE HAZE SET .

Name: Best Sellers Set
Description: TRY THE BEST OUR UNIVERSE HAS TO OFFER. the BEST SELLERS SET includes six of our all-time best selling lacquers: 404: SOUL NOT FOUND , QUEEN OF THE DEAD , AM I EVERYTHING YOU FEAR? , HOUSE OF HADES , MERMAID BAIT , and SAND VIPER . note: includes one free magnetic wand.

Name: Beware, the Kraken
Description: LEGEND HAS IT… that in the wake of trident storms, beneath the magnetized current of violet skies, a slithering sea beast has been known to surface, lured by the promise of peril above. pray ye never make his many-tentacled acquaintance. or ye will be cursed to swim with the fishes forevermore. BEWARE, THE KRAKEN is a deep violet magnetic multichrome lacquer filled with reflective glitter that creates a color-shifting olive-magenta-peach stripe. from the EXPEDITION: ATLANTIS set . A NOTE FOR SMOOTH SAILS: reflective magnetic lacquers are highly textured and should be finished with 1-2 layers of our SPEED DEMON TOP COAT . note: all orders with magnetic lacquers include one free magnetic wand

Name: Black Widow
Description: MEET YOUR MATE. BLACK WIDOW is a red magnetic lacquer that reveals a black base when magnetized. from the DEADLY BY NATURE SET .

Name: Blame My Star Sign
Description: YOU WERE DESTINED FOR A LITTLE CHAOS. it’s written in your chart, after all. you’re a deviant sun. a rising misfit. but really, at your core, just a sappy, shiny, sparkly little emosh moon. wear your true colors in all of their chaotic splendor with this fittingly complex charcoal jelly glitter lacquer. BLAME MY STAR SIGN is a charcoal lacquer filled with holographic glitter.

Name: Blood Moon
Description: it’s rare. it’s celestial. it’s a blood moon, baby. this linear lacquer entrances the eye with a deep red shimmer and linear holo flare that obscure its black base. dangerously alluring, BLOOD MOON draws you in every time. BLOOD MOON is a black linear holographic lacquer filled with red shimmer. note: holographic lacquers look best in the sunlight or under a direct light, where they reveal their full rainbow effect. in the shade or overcast conditions, the effect will be more muted (but still mesmerizing).

Name: Bloodbender
Description: PERFECT THE TECHNIQUE + YOU CAN CONTROL ANYTHING… BLOODBENDER is a blue magnetic lacquer that reveals a deep burgundy base when magnetized. from our AVATAR: THE LAST AIRBENDER collaboration collection - and only available for a limited time. wear + care: features a limited-edition waterbending bottle design with a special gold cap + a limited-edition WATER TRIBE carton for maximum opacity, we recommend applying 2-3 coats note: this item only ships to the US and CANADA. © 2025 Viacom International Inc.

Name: Bloodhound
Description: BEWARE OF THE LACQUER. BLOODHOUND is a deep cranberry red lacquer. From the SUNDOG SET .

Name: Blueberry's Jam
Description: FRESHLY BOTTLED FROM PLANET NYARR. BLUEBERRY’S JAM is a magenta-pink magnetic lacquer that reveals a blue base jam-packed with flakies and reflective glitter when magnetized. From the PLANET NYARR SET. Need a magnetic wand? Add a free one in cart to create magnetic designs. Wear + Care: Reflective sparkle appears under camera/phone flash + very bright direct light

Name: Boa Constrictor
Description: PREPARE TO BE AMBUSHED. the holographic glint of its slithering chocolate brown scales is a thing of legend. but should this slinking predator emerge far enough from the brush-lined shadows for you to fully behold it, it’ll already be far too late. try as you might to wriggle away from its ever-winding coil, you’ll never truly be able to free yourself from its hypnotic grasp. BOA CONSTRICTO R is a chocolate linear holographic lacquer. from the HEAVY IS THE CROWN collection. note: holographic lacquers look best in the sunlight or under a direct light, where they reveal their full rainbow effect. in the shade or overcast conditions, the effect will be more muted (but still mesmerizing).

Name: Bootlegger
Description: MISSING THIS SHOULD BE PROHIBITED. smuggle yourself a bottle of our warmest new nightshade. mixed to perfection, this tall bottle o’ warm brandy-whiskey-like brown lacquer is shimmering with subtle, red-orange glints of iridescence - that may just leave you feeling all warm and fuzzy inside. BOOTLEGGER is a whiskey brown lacquer filled with red-orange shimmer. from the MIDNIGHT RODEO SET .

Name: Bottled Rage
Description: UNCAP YOUR FEELINGS. let a furious wave of dark burgundy red wash over your claws steeped to perfection in aged anguish + dread now ready to ignite your paws in simmering glimmers of fiery orange + red iridescent embers that once didn’t make a peep now ready to be unleashed no longer festering so deep BOTTLED RAGE is a dark burgundy red-black lacquer filled with red-orange shimmer. from the MY INNER APOCALYPSE: AN EP FOR EXISTENTIAL DAYS SET .

Name: Breath of Wind
Description: CLEARLY A MASTER OF EVASIVE MANEUVERING. BREATH OF WIND is a gray to white thermal lacquer filled with blue shimmer, that transitions from a shade of smokey gray when cold to white when warm. from our AVATAR: THE LAST AIRBENDER collaboration collection - and only available for a limited time. wear + care: features a limited-edition airbending bottle design with a special gold cap + a limited-edition AIR NOMADS carton thermal effects may vary based on body chemistry, temperature, + climate. this shade’s color transition may also evolve with wear, as results can differ from person to person. formula tends to be thicker due to the special pigments used. when needed, simply add a few drops of LACQUER REVITALIZER , to revive its consistency. use a base coat + SPEED DEMON TOP COAT to prevent chipping + extend wear note: this item only ships to the US and CANADA. © 2025 Viacom International Inc.

Name: Castle of Cobwebs
Description: CHAPTER VI: CAUGHT IN THE AFTERGLOW. you come aglow at night. but by day you’d never know it. in the sunlight, you’re shrouded in a tangled gray web a-mist with fresh, shimmering dew drops, suspended like the most dramatic micro teardrops, that hang like an impending gloom on the horizon. only come nightfall, does that familiar, fiendish green glow return. like a ghost, only a figment of once was. CASTLE OF COBWEBS ​​is a slate gray glow-in-the-dark lacquer filled w ith blue shimmer that glows green in the dark. from the BAROQUEN SET . for best glow-in-the-dark results: give your bottle a little shake before applying. for the brightest glow, we recommend applying 3 coats. don’t skip your top coat. once you’re done painting, activate the glow by holding your nails under direct light for ~30 seconds. shut off the lights and prepare to fright. to recharge the glow effect, just hold your nails under direct light again. note: due to the highly-pigmented nature of this lacquer, its consistency will gradually grow thicker over time. when needed, simply add a few drops of nail polish thinner, to revitalize the formula.

Name: Catfished
Description: DECEPTION NEVER LOOKED SO GOOD. wait a second. did a “mermaid” tell you to meet them here at “CRYSTAL LAKE,” too? ha ha. awkwarddd... bc no matter when or where or how you view this ever-shifting blue creature it never seems to look quite the same as before. and that’s oh-so-deliberately by design. thanks to its beautifully briny, ULTRA-fine flakie-packed formula, it perma-morphs between transfixing waves of teal, blue, and green hues. sure, i think it’s safe to say that this shade’s no lake - it’s more of an epic, sprawling, ocean-sized blue tincture filled with truly unfathomable mystery. consider us pleasantly deceived. CATFISHED is an ocean blue lacquer jam-packed with blue ULTRA-fine flakies and super micro holographic glitter. from the MERMAID TALES SET .

Name: Chaotic Neutrals Set
Description: EXPECT THE UNEXPECTED. we’ve conjured a collection of our most unnerving neutrals. rich with mystical mayhem, this set of 6 lacquers will have you screaming not-so-subtleties—with sandy shimmers and magnetics, golden holographics, muted cremes, and everything in between. these hypnotizing shades will change everything you thought you knew about neutrals… the CHAOTIC NEUTRALS SET includes 6 neutral lacquers: SAND VIPER , BOA CONSTRICTOR , FAKE HALO , DARK HORSE , NEPTUNE’S SAND , and A DOLL’S HOUSE .

Name: Clair De Lune
Description: AN UNSHAKEABLE CLASSIC. CLAIR DE LUNE is a light purple magnetic lacquer that reveals a dusty purple mauve base when magnetized. from the DANSE MACABRE SET . wear + care once applied, it’s normal for the color to darken slightly over time

Name: Cosmic Cowboy
Description: GIDDY UP, HIGH HORSE. you’ll feel like the coolest cat at the cosmic disco with this high-flying shade of cobalt. lace up your favorite platform boots and let this totally d y n a m i t e shade lasso you in, as it twirls through an intergalactic wave of iridescent peach and magenta hues. COSMIC COWBOY is a bright cobalt jelly lacquer filled with peach and magenta iridescent flakies. its buildable formula can be layered to your liking, for either a semi-sheer or more opaque look. from the KALEIDOSCOPE HAZE SET .

Name: Cruel Mirage
Description: think you’ve found a rainbow? it’s just a cruel mirage. this black linear holographic lacquer shows arcs of color that shine in the light one moment, then disappear into darkness the next. CRUEL MIRAGE is always mysterious, always changing, and full of surprises. CRUEL MIRAGE is a black linear holographic lacquer. formerly known as FOCUS note: holographic lacquers look best in the sunlight or under a direct light, where they reveal their full rainbow effect. in the shade or overcast conditions, the effect will be more muted (but still mesmerizing).

Name: Curiosity's Prey
Color(s): Blue, Green, Multichrome/Shift, Orange, Pink, White
Description: OPAL OF MY EYE. let your curiosities get the best of you. no wandering eye or racing mind is immune to the hypnotizing allure of this glistening white gem. as iridescent flakies flicker through a rainbow reef of glimmering marine shades and a cool wave of indigo shimmer washes over claws, it’ll leave you clutching your metaphoric pearls, positively transfixed. CURIOSITY’S PREY is a sheer white jelly lacquer filled with pink, orange, and green iridescent flakies and indigo iridescent shimmer. note: this shade has an intentionally ethereal sheerness. for the glowiest look, we recommend applying only 1-2 coats.

Name: Curiosity's Trap
Description: WILL IT GET THE BEST OF YOU? can you resist the pull of this mesmerizing blue magnetic? there’s just something about this captivating concoction, gilded with micro gold flakes, that feels both invigorating…and endlessly foreboding…if you’re daring enough to give your wand a wave and see what your curiosity conjures, you may just as easily summon the glory of gorgeous golden hour rays…or the horror of getting swept away in a velvety swirl of a sand-filled tide… CURIOSITY’S TRAP is a blue magnetic lacquer with micro gold flakies that reveals a golden yellow magnetic stripe. from the PANDORA UNBOXED SET .

Name: Curse Of Calypso
Description: THIS WON’T BE A LOVE UNREQUITED. but this hypnotizing shade may gain an inescapable hold over your heart. immerse your claws in a coat of this serene, sheer lilac-pink lacquer and, like ever-encroaching seas, its mesmerizing wash of gold-to-green shimmer will make you momentarily forget about all other lacquers past. CURSE OF CALYPSO is a sheer lilac-pink lacquer filled with color-shifting gold-to-green shimmer that looks most divine in the shade. from the GODDESS COMPLEX SET . note: this shade has an intentionally ethereal sheerness, but can be layered to your liking over a coat of our GETTING EVEN NAIL PRIMER for a more opaque look.

Name: Cyborg Tears
Description: EMOTIONALLY CHARGED. CYBORG TEARS is light blue-silver metallic holographic lacquer. from the WELCOME TO PARADISE SET . wear + care: holographic flare appears in sunlight or direct light appears more metallic in the shade or overcast conditions

Name: Danse Macabre
Description: YOUR OWN PERSONAL HORRORSHOW. the DANSE MACABRE SET includes 8 nail lacquers: THE DOPPELGANGER , PEARL CLUTCHER , HELL IS OTHER PEOPLE , HEART ON A PLATTER , THE LIVING DOLL , CLAIR DE LUNE , THE SILENT SCREAM , and REQUIEM FOR A SWAN . all orders with magnetic lacquers include one free magnetic wand.

Name: Dark Arts 101 Set
Description: welcome to the dark side. this compendium is an essential addition for any MOONCAT who perpetually flirts with their inner darkness. with five moody cremes, each as ~dark as your soul~, this set will light an infernal flame in your heart and carve out an eternal place in your lacquer rotation. the DARK ARTS 101 SET set includes EMO FOR LIFE , a one-coat black creme lacquer, INTO THE ABYSS , a deep midnight creme lacquer, POISON IVY , a rich forest creme lacquer, FROM THE ASHES , a sultry oxblood creme lacquer, and QUEEN OF CHAOS , a regal amethyst creme lacquer.

Name: Dark Horse
Description: DON’T UNDERESTIMATE ‘EM. don’t hold your horses on this rich, highly-pigmented, deep chocolate brown shimmer. add it to your lacquer collection and watch as this unexpected challenger inevitably emerges victorious. with a subtle glimmering shift of warm, light brown shimmer, this moody hue’ll hold your gaze til the cows come home. DARK HORSE is a dark brown lacquer filled with warm, light brown shimmer. from the MIDNIGHT RODEO SET . note: due to the highly-pigmented nature of this lacquer, its consistency will gradually grow thicker over time. when needed, simply add a few drops of nail polish thinner, to revitalize the formula.

Name: Dark Instruments Set
Description: DARK VISIONS, CRYSTALIZE. summon these dark instruments and watch as the nails you’ve prothesized quickly take impeccable shape. the DARK INSTRUMENTS SET includes a SHAPESHIFTER , a crystal file essential for perfecting the craft of stealthful nail transformation, THE VANISHER , a magical clean-up brush known to make lacquer smudges quickly disappear, and a BOUNDARY PUSHER , a double-edged crystal tool that’ll help you achieve ultimate cuticle clarity.

Name: Dark Night of the Soul
Description: TRANSCEND EVEN THE DARKEST NIGHT. even at the pit of the darkest depths, the most pained fringes of the mind, the hungriest pangs of the soul, there is still a light. past every ounce of agony, glint of rage, and twitch of torment, even beyond the deepest depths of seemingly endless, all-encroaching midnight, thrashing there, in that existential wave, is the faintest glimmer of hope, blue as daylight, eagerly outstretched, ready to embrace, uplift, and fuel the newly emergent you. DARK NIGHT OF THE SOUL is a bright purple lacquer filled with blue shimmer. from the FALLEN SET .

Name: Dark Omens
Description: EXPLORE YOUR DARKEST HUNCHES. like a pit in your stomach. or the jolt in your heart. field signs from the fathoms beneath with a thermal lacquer prone to pick up every sinister sea change. mashed from inklings of doubt, fear, and dread, this enchanted tincture will come alive with your claws’ every foreboding fluctuation in temperature. should your paws grow a bit clammy, you’ll see your claws transition from a deep, dark shade of purple to a shade of light purple, like the most disquieting mood ring. and as you’re overcome with even the faintest hint of a bone-tingling chill, you’ll watch as your claws become slowly acrawl with the ghastly purple-black shadow of all things doom and gloom yet again. what beauty will you uncover in the dark? DARK OMENS is a dark purple thermal lacquer that transitions from a shade of deep, dark purple when cold to a shade of light purple when warm. from the SONGS OF SIRENS SET . note: apply three coats for optimal opacity. due to its unique formula, you may notice that this lacquer has a slightly stronger scent than our other shades, particularly if you are sensitive to scents. it can take up to a few hours for the color transitioning effect to be activated for the first time. applying GETTING EVEN NAIL PRIMER as a base + topping this shade with SPEED DEMON TOP COA T is required to prevent chipping + prolong its wear. how a thermal lacquer looks + transitions may vary based on your body chemistry, room conditions, + current climate.

Name: DARK SPELLS DUO
Description: prepare to be transformed. this bewitching duo features two transfixing toppers, each known to quickly cast an unshakeable spell over any lacquer it touches. the DARK SPELLS DUO includes FOXFIRE , an iridescent flakie topper that shifts between shades of green, turquoise, and violet, and MOONDUST , a clear top coat filled with holographic silver glitter.

Name: Deadly By Nature Set
Description: INSPIRED BY NATURE’S MOST DEADLY FLORA AND FAUNA… the DEADLY BY NATURE SET includes 6 nail lacquers: BLACK WIDOW , DEADLY NIGHTSHADE , WEREWOLF’S BANE , DEATH’S TRUMPET , TAIPAN VENOM , and MANCHINEEL TREE . all orders with magnetic lacquers include one free magnetic wand.

Name: Deadly Nightshade
Description: YOU’LL NEVER BE THE SAME. DEADLY NIGHTSHADE is an ultra shifty shimmer lacquer that color-shifts between shades of purple, teal, green, gold, and blue as it’s viewed from different angles. from the DEADLY BY NATURE SET . wear + care: DEADLY NIGHTSHADE shifts dramatically with changes in lighting and angles, often appearing as entirely different colors no single image can capture its full appearance. please view all photos to experience the full spectrum of its color shift

Name: Death's Trumpet
Description: DANCE THROUGH DELIRIUM. DEATH’S TRUMPET is a sheer pink solar lacquer filled with blue shimmer that transitions to a bright shade of purple in its sun-activated state. from the DEADLY BY NATURE SET . wear + care: solar lacquer changes color in sunlight strong UV creates a more intense shift, while low UV results in a subtler change color change intensity and duration may vary with temperature color change effect may diminish over time this shade has an intentionally sheerness, but can be layered to your liking designed and tested for compatibility with SPEED DEMON TOP COAT

Name: Demeter’s Harvest
Description: NOT TO BE CORNY, BUT… if you go against the grain and pick this gilded shade, it’ll def prove fruitful. after all, this *is* the shade you’ve been waiting for. and, yes, it has the juice – a mesmerizing wave of color-shifting yellow-to-red-to-green shimmer that twinkles against its regal, golden base. it may have you feeling like you could travel to the depths of the underworld and back again. or, you know, just feeling lowkey godly. DEMETER’S HARVEST is a golden lacquer filled with color-shifting yellow-to-red-to-green shimmer. from the GODDESS COMPLEX SET . named by @frogtimebaby on tiktok.

Name: Devil's Ivy
Description: AWAKEN A LOVE LIKE SPRINGTIME. this is your reprieve. like perennial tendrils, help your claws reemerge from even the darkest depths with this v grounding green. like springtime in a bottle, this sage lacquer is swirling with silver glints of the divine for a look that’s truly magnetic. with the simple wave of your magnetic wand, watch as its soft, magnetic silver pigment gets pulled under your spell, like a sudden sprouting of mystical offshoots, spun into a velvety bloom or a sharp cascading cat eye. DEVIL’S IVY is a sage green magnetic lacquer that reveals a silver magnetic stripe. from the SEASONS OF PERSEPHONE SET .

Name: Dewpearls
Description: 露珠 | PRETEND YOU’RE A MORNING-MISTED BLOSSOM… and gather daubs of this iridescent icy blue shimmer. like the memory of dew crested mornings once past, quiet, fresh, and delicately coated in the glimmer of possibility, every moment with this ever-shifting icy blue to pink to purple shade is like daybreak anew. DEWPEARLS is an icy blue lacquer filled with color-shifting purple-to-pink shimmer. from the REMEDY SET . note: we recommend applying 3 coats of this shade for full opacity + impact.

Name: Dragon Scales
Description: UNLEASH YOUR TRUE COLORS. here be bottled dragon’s armor... lest your enemies forget there be magma running through your veins. for excalibur-caliber protection, simply cloak your claws in this mystical, ever-shifting rainbow of reptilian-like chain mail. it’ll keep your opponents in a constant state of SHOCK and AWE as each slick scale slithers through magnificent shades of magenta and lime. and momentarily distracts from escaping embers of your ever-growing inner fire. DRAGON SCALES is a multichrome flakie lacquer filled with holographic glitter that shifts between shades of magenta and lime green. this is JAM SESSION 2.0. WARNING: this product can expose you to chemicals including chromium, which is known to the state of CALIFORNIA to cause cancer and reproductive harm. for more information visit www.p65warnings.ca.gov

Name: Dream Machine
Description: SWEET DREAMS ARE MADE OF THIS RAREMADE REWARDS-EXCLUSIVE HUE. DREAM MACHINE is a limited-edition pink RAREMADE lacquer filled with golden shimmer + both pink + silver holographic glitter. only available for reward redemption in THE MISFITS CLUB while supplies last. wear + care: what’s a RAREMADE lacquer? sometimes, a pigment batch arrives looking slightly different (in color, size, etc.) than what we approved, + can’t be used for an intended shade. RAREMADES reimagine these perfectly usable, but unintentionally unique, limited pigment batches into something truly one-of-a-kind. note: only 1 bottle of this lacquer can be redeemed per order.

Name: Dream Within A Dream
Description: IS THIS REAL OR JUST A DREAM? like a beautiful nightmare, this deep purple matte lacquer is much more complex than it initially seems. once unearthed from the clouds, disorienting hints of red, violet, and blue shimmer dance defiantly against its dusk-like backdrop. DREAM WITHIN A DREAM is a matte deep purple lacquer filled with red, violet, and blue shimmer. while this quick-dry matte lacquer doesn’t require a top coat, you can put a new spin on your narrative by finishing it with our glossy SPEED DEMON TOP COAT .

Name: Drown My Demons
Description: TREAD FRIGHTFULLY. drown my demons teach me how to swim magnetize the green of springtime from within so i can escape the great blue as it encroaches in drown my demons even awash in the great ocean blue, even adrift out to sea i magnetize their beady green eyes, they see they find me DROWN MY DEMONS is a deep ocean blue magnetic lacquer that reveals a green magnetic stripe. from the MY INNER APOCALYPSE: AN EP FOR EXISTENTIAL DAYS SET . note: for the best magnetic effect, we recommend magnetizing this shade from above. immediately after applying lacquer, hold your magnetic wand above your nail for at least 30 sec.

Name: Earth To Gaia
Description: PUT THE WHOLE WORLD IN YOUR HANDS. giver of life. protector of claws. it’s easy to see why this wholly serene green has quickly become anointed as a shade of the divine. with a v down-to-earth sheer jade base, an out-of-this-world pink shimmer, and a mystical jolt of holographic glitter, this lush lacquer will quickly have your claws feeling on top of the world. EARTH TO GAIA is a sheer jade green lacquer with pink shimmer and micro holographic glitter that looks most divine in the sun. from the GODDESS COMPLEX SET . note: this shade has an intentionally ethereal sheerness, but can be layered to your liking over a coat of our GETTING EVEN NAIL PRIMER for a more opaque look.

Name: Ego Stroker 9000
Description: STOP. YOU’RE MAKING YOURSELF BLUSH. EGO STROKER 9000 is a hot pink metallic holographic lacquer. from the WELCOME TO PARADISE SET . wear + care: holographic flare appears in sunlight or direct light appears more metallic in the shade or overcast conditions

Name: Electromagnetic Furball
Description: DISGUSTINGLY BEAUTIFUL. ELECTROMAGNETIC FURBALL is a magenta-pink multichrome magnetic lacquer that reveals a base jam-packed with bronze flakies and multicolored reflective glitter when magnetized. From the PLANET NYARR SET . Need a magnetic wand? Add a free one in cart to create magnetic designs. Wear + Care: For maximum opacity, we recommend applying 3 coats Reflective sparkle appears under camera/phone flash and very bright direct light

Name: Emo for Life
Description: THIS IS OUR ANTHEM. offering full coverage in just 1 coat, our signature ink-black creme will help you quickly match the color of your claws to the precise shade of your deep, dark soul. meaning: unless you’re in the business of misery, you’ll be relieved to hear that our signature creme is * s o * not like those other streaky, sad, black nail shades that may have cut your heart into pieces and broken you down so badly (in the worst way) before. this one will have you leading your own black lacquer parade, as it immediately wins over your cold, dark heart. and swears to never break it. EMO FOR LIFE is a rich black creme lacquer.

Name: Enchanted Mist
Color(s): Gray, Green, Multichrome/Shift, Orange, Purple, Red, Teal
Description: mystical sightings have been reported this way. venture carefully into the emerging haze. the deeper you wander, the more likely you are to spot mythical swells of iridescent red-orange-green and green-turquoise-violet flakies fluttering romantically against the light gray jelly expanse. and the longer you linger, the more likely you’ll be to catching them shift right before your very eyes. ENCHANTED MIST is a light gray jelly lacquer filled with color-shifting iridescent flakies.

Name: Epilogue to Utopia
Description: BONUS SCENES FROM THE EDGE OF PARADISE. EPILOGUE TO UTOPIA is a highly-pigmented multichrome magnetic lacquer that shifts between indigo blue and purple, and reveals a black base when magnetized. from the WELCOME TO PARADISE SET . wear + care: this shade can look dramatically different depending on the magnetization method, lighting, or angle it’s viewed from no one photo will truly capture its full appearance. we recommend viewing all photos to see the full range

Name: Eternal Sunshine
Description: WELCOME TO THE LAND OF THE MIDNIGHT SUN. where a bright wash of daffodil sunshine lingers day and night. wrapping you in a warm, inescapable wave of light. whether it’s a world of utopian bliss or dystopian fright...we’ll let your imagination decide. ETERNAL SUNSHINE is a light yellow creme lacquer. from the TECHNICOLOR DREAMS collection.

Name: Euphoric
Description: THIS MUST BE CLOUD 9. get a taste of pure ecstasy. as you float on air and view the world through romantic orchid colored glasses. it’s an incomparable high that you’ll forever chase and one that’s perpetually slipping just through your fingertips. EUPHORIC is an orchid pink creme lacquer. from the TECHNICOLOR DREAMS collection.

Name: Extra Celestial
Description: THE ASTRONOMICAL IMPACT OF THIS RAREMADE REWARDS-EXCLUSIVE HUE... EXTRA CELESTIAL is a limited-edition purple RAREMADE lacquer filled with pink shimmer, ULTRA-fine holographic flakies, + both pink + silver holographic glitter. only available for reward redemption in THE MISFITS CLUB while supplies last. wear + care: what’s a RAREMADE lacquer? sometimes, a pigment batch arrives looking slightly different (in color, size, etc.) than what we approved, + can’t be used for an intended shade. RAREMADES reimagine these perfectly usable, but unintentionally unique, limited pigment batches into something truly one-of-a-kind. note: only 1 bottle of this lacquer can be redeemed per order.

Name: Fake Halo
Description: CALLING ALL FALLEN ANGELS. did it hurt? when you fell from heaven? because it looks like you dropped your signature hue. don’t let its angelic glow fool you. this seemingly delicate rose gold beacon reveals the full spectrum of its true colors - and a real devilish rainbow flare - when viewed directly in the light. FAKE HALO is a rose gold linear holographic lacquer. note: holographic lacquers look best in the sunlight or under a direct light, where they reveal their full rainbow effect. in the shade or overcast conditions, the effect will be more muted (but still mesmerizing). as featured on BUZZFEED, ELLE, and HARPER'S BAZAAR. "this holographic lacquer glows and is constantly shifting with literally every color of the rainbow as it hits the light, so you're never looking at the same nails twice." – BUZZFEED

Name: Fallen Angels
Description: cool yet contemplative. hopefulness comes in the somber spirit of a new beginning. this shade casts a new light on the tale of a condemned soul. FALLEN ANGELS is a smokey gray lacquer filled with blue and purple shimmer.

Name: Fallen Set
Description: WE’RE SHEDDING WHAT NO LONGER SERVES US… and entering a new season of reflection, renewal, and growth. sink your claws beneath the leaves you’ve now outgrown and join us as we journey through an invigorating palette of soothing shimmers, energizing magnetics, transformative thermals, and an ever-shifting multichrome - each ready to help you lay the roots of your next chapter. how will you and your claws re-emerge? we can’t wait to see… the FALLEN SET includes 10 special effect nail lacquers: SAGEBRUSH , TWILIGHT SONATA , NOCTURNE , WITCH HAZEL , JEWEL BEETLE , MEMENTO MORI , POEMS FOR A HARVEST MOON , AFTER THE RAIN , FIELDS OF LAVENDER , and DARK NIGHT OF THE SOUL . all orders with magnetic lacquers include one free magnetic wand .

Name: Fields of Elysium
Description: FRESH FROM THE NETHERWORLD. leave your worries in acheron. dip your claws into a fruitful green oasis free from earthly toil. this muted sage shimmer has managed to muffle any characteristically terrestrial troubles and tribulations, replacing them with a sky full of ever-glittering holo and an ultra-glowy field blooming with shimmering violet. it’s a feeling so eerily divine. FIELDS OF ELYSIUM ​​is a muted sage lacquer filled with violet shimmer and micro holographic glitter. from the SEASONS OF PERSEPHONE SET .

Name: Fields of Lavender
Description: FROLIC THROUGH A SUPERBLOOM OF SERENITY. take your claws for a stroll through this perennial pick-me-up. once magnetized, its lush purple backdrop will come aglow with an energizing burst of red-orange beams, like the fiercest rush of setting sunlight. whether you harness the red-orange rays into a fierce cat-eye or a more abstract, velvety bloom, may it help you create a most-mindful, personal wonderland – even just for a little while. FIELDS OF LAVENDER is a mauve purple magnetic lacquer that reveals a red-orange magnetic stripe. from the FALLEN SET . note: for the sharpest cat eye, we recommend using your magnet over your nail after every coat (including your top coat).

Name: Firewall
Description: HALT. WHO GOES THERE? this is the last line of defense. a tightly woven string of shimmering silver-to-olive-green armor adorned like warpaint. a symbolic promise to protect our fortress at all costs. from all of the digital monsters, demons, and creepy crawlers that go bump in the dark of night. FIREWALL is a multichrome lacquer that shifts between shades of silver and olive green as it’s viewed from different angles. from the GLITCH IN THE MATRIX collection.

Name: Fleur Sauvage
Description: CHAPTER I: A MOST REBELLIOUS BLOOM. it’ll overcome you like a weed...the wildest flower. in a defiant pop of light poppy orange, which some might whisper “unrefined,” the flock of overly pristine blossoms and hedges in its wake now, somehow, have you feeling so…blasé. as the spotlight sets them a-blush in a chromey pink sheen, this glimmery blossom dares to overtake the garden of your mind. like a thorn in your side, i fear you simply won’t be able to shake the memory of its impact. FLEUR SAUVAGE is a light orange lacquer filled with chromey pink shimmer. from the BAROQUEN SET .

Name: Flight Of The Monarchs
Description: WITH THESE WINGS… break out of your chrysalis and let your inner butterfly take flight. anoint your claws with this high-flying tincture and watch as they metamorphosize, fluttering through an otherworldly wave of shimmering orange-to-amber-to-pink-to-purple hues. FLIGHT OF THE MONARCHS is an orange lacquer filled with color-shifting orange-to-amber-to-pink-to-purple shimmer. from the LOST IN A FOLKTALE SET .

Name: Flying Nimbus
Description: 筋斗雲 | SCENES FROM AN EVER-CHANGING SKY. set your imagination adrift with your every shift in fahrenheit. against the blueness of sky, unbottle a story told in cloud-like shapes that constantly roll by. cold paws mean clear, blue claws ahead. and as your claws warm, a wave of soft white will gradually creep in and float on by… FLYING NIMBUS is a sky blue-to-white thermal lacquer that transitions from a shade of sky blue when cold to white when warm. from the REMEDY SET . note: due to the nature of the special pigments used, this lacquer will have a thicker formula. it may also cause some separation to occur in bottle. this is normal + won’t affect the application or finish. simply shake well before each use. how a thermal lacquer looks + transitions may vary based on your body chemistry, room conditions, + current climate. it can take up to a few hours for the color transitioning effect to be activated for the first time. applying a base coat + finishing this shade with SPEED DEMON TOP COAT is required to prevent chipping + prolong its wear.

Name: Fool's Gold Topper
Description: NOW EVERYTHING’S GOOD AS GOLD. you don’t have to mine the depths to find a treasured new shade all your own - just top all your favorite lacquers with a gilded layer of this golden topper. preserved in a clear matte base, this transformative accessory will adorn any treasured preexisting shade with nuggets o’ faux-gold flakes. the only fool here is the cat who skips out on this ultra luminous prospect. FOOL’S GOLD is a matte topper featuring golden flakies in a clear base. from the MIDNIGHT RODEO SET . finish with a coat of MATTE MADE IN HELL to lock in your look + prolong your wear. not a matte fan? just top this shade w SPEED DEMON TOP COAT for a glossy finish.

Name: Forbidden Cove
Description: find more than what you were seeking get lost in this inky black jelly lacquer — deep and dark, yet glimmering with a rainbow of colored flakies. FORBIDDEN COVE is a black jelly lacquer filled with color-shifting iridescent flakies.

Name: Forbidden Fruit
Description: PLUCKED FROM A POISONOUS TREE. will you let your claws dip into their most forbidden temptations? aged to perfection in the most intoxicating deep burgundy base, this freshly fallen brew boasts something truly magnetizing. bright and appley-green at its core it almost seems too good to be true. and maybe it is… tilt it ever so slightly and its pristine veneer begins to immediately yellow. sure, maybe you should just let it be. or you could pluck this surely sinister tincture and use your magnetic wand to slice it with a crisp green-yellow stripe or meld it into an entrancing green-yellow velvet. so why not give your claws a taste… FORBIDDEN FRUIT is a dark burgundy magnetic multichrome lacquer that reveals a color-shifting green-to-yellow magnetic stripe. from the PANDORA UNBOXED SET .

Name: Foxfire
Description: GIVE ANY LACQUER A LITERAL GLOW UP. set your favorite shades aglow with this mystical, color-shifting topper. filled with an enchanting assortment of iridescent flakies, this luminescent topper will continually surprise and delight you - revealing a unique appearance depending on what base lacquer you pair it with. FOXFIRE is an iridescent flakie topper that shifts between shades of green, turquoise, and violet.

Name: Freshly Bitten
Description: A POMEGRANATE RED TO FEED ALL YOUR CRAVINGS… we heard you had a hunger for flesh… pomegranate flesh. so feast your claws on our shimmering pomegranate-y, red slice of the deepest, darkest paradise. plucked from a thornybud and steeped in a rich red wine, this intoxicating lacquer packs juicy glints of ever-divine pink and fiendish purple shimmer, that’ll color-shift more than your ever-variant desires. just one taste may have a world-altering effect over your claws… FRESHLY BITTEN is a rich wine red lacquer filled with purple-to-pink shimmer. from the SEASONS OF PERSEPHONE SET .

Name: Freudian Slip
Description: DON’T READ INTO THIS TOO DEEPLY. it’s exactly what it looks like: a perfect mauve purple. dreamlike, yet ripe with just the right amount of melancholia. it’s a hue that’ll have you endlessly circling lacquer – wait. ha. did we just say ‘circling lacquer?’ we totally meant to say ~back here.~ it’ll have you endlessly circling back here. anyway, we’re just trying to nail you – whoa, sorry, ‘tell’ you… that we just paint…ugh, i mean, ‘CAN’T’... that we *clearly* just CAN’T get this truly thought-provoking purple shade off our minds. FREUDIAN SLIP is a mauve purple creme lacquer. from the A TALE OF 5 LACQUERS SET .

Name: From The Ashes
Description: UNSCATHED, UNSHAKEN, BUT NEVER UNVARNISHED. like the catalyzing embers of the phoenix, this deep oxblood creme lacquer may just propel you to paint your own transformative origin story. FROM THE ASHES is a deep oxblood red creme lacquer.

Name: Full Scream Ahead
Description: LIKE A RADIOACTIVE AHHHHHHH! IN A BOTTLE. merrily we RAGE on in SCREAMS of glowing mint green woes and wallow at a HIGHLY-VOLATILE full-throttle merrily we BARREL on UNSTOPPABLE, shrieking in glittering throes of silver shimmering holo like a JOLT of released steam to make a display that’s always undeniably EXTREME FULL SCREAM AHEAD ​​is a light mint green holographic shimmer. from the MY INNER APOCALYPSE: AN EP FOR EXISTENTIAL DAYS SET .

Name: Game Over
Description: it’s game over... there's no turning back for this cunning holographic lacquer. this bright red shade glows with an intensity and rage that just won’t quit. game over is a bright rosy red polish with a linear holographic flare. GAME OVER is a rosy red linear holographic lacquer. note: holographic lacquers look best in the sunlight or under a direct light, where they reveal their full rainbow effect. in the shade or overcast conditions, the effect will be more muted (but still mesmerizing).

Name: Garden of Evil
Description: DIP INTO A REALM OF PURE DEVIANCE. heathens must be missing a lacquer. bc once your claws get a taste of this sinister shade they may not have eyes for any other. mashed from a most forbidden fruit, this reptilian green tincture features a sinister slither of ultra-iridescent violet-pink shimmer and vexing pops of micro holographic glitter. GARDEN OF EVIL is a green lacquer filled with violet shimmer and micro holographic glitter. from the SEASONS OF PERSEPHONE SET . note: the appearance of this shade changes dramatically under different lighting conditions (i.e. in the shade vs. in the sun). we recommend viewing all photos to see the range of its shifts.

Name: Gates Of Hell
Description: THE UNDERWORLD MUST BE MISSING A LACQUER. abandon all hope and dip headfirst into the unseen realm. your perma-portal to the underworld, this delightfully nefarious shade will overtake your mortal claws with a sinister wave of color-shifting red-to-black shimmer and devilish glints of micro holo. simply uncap it again and again when your paws pang with cravings to return to the dark side. GATES OF HELL is a color-shifting black-to-red multichrome lacquer with micro holo glitter. from the UNDERWORLD SET .

Name: Getting Even Nail Primer
Description: DON’T GET MAD. GET EVEN. you deserve a clean slate. our ridge filler base coat will let you start fresh with each and every manicure, as it lays down an enviably smooth and even foundation. with a lightly tinted formula, it’ll also gently conceal any unwanted nail staining, and can be layered to create the perfect semi-sheer base for nail art. somewhere in the multiverse your nail rivals are already shaking with envy. our GETTING EVEN NAIL PRIMER is a lightly pink-tinted, ridge filler base coat that creates a smooth and even foundation. note: can be worn alone or over a layer of our HARDCORE BASE COAT .

Name: Ghost Ship
Description: HAVE YOU HEARD THE TALE… …of the lost ship cursed to forever sail? catch a glimpse of the glimmer of the ghastly blue shimmer across a stormy purple sky and you may not believe your eyes…for drifting above the magnetized horizons, you may just catch a glimpse of a silvery specter pulled into many spirited shapes across the holo-twinkling twilight… GHOST SHIP is a royal purple magnetic lacquer filled with blue shimmer and micro holographic glitter that reveals a bright silver magnetic stripe. from the SONGS OF SIRENS SET .

Name: Ghosts Of Hecate
Description: TRUE NECROMANCE. in the wake of glazed donut nails past comes a sheer white shade stirred from the brightest pockets of the underworld. unspool this devilishly divine tincture and summon an otherworldly flurry of glowing blue-to-purple specters and glittering holographic orbs for a spellbinding display that can only be described as pure witchcraft. GHOSTS OF HECATE is a sheer white lacquer filled with color-shifting blue-to-purple shimmer and micro holographic glitter that looks most divine in the shade. from the GODDESS COMPLEX SET . note: this shade has an intentionally ethereal sheerness, but can be layered to your liking over a coat of our GETTING EVEN NAIL PRIMER for a more opaque look.

Name: Green Eyed Monster
Description: THE SPAWN OF ENVY. ready to set your claw-versaries aglow with jealousy? we extracted the shadow demon buried in your most fermented resentment and bottled it in the most enviable hue. deceptively demure during the day, this subdued white, filled with just a glimmer of green shimmer, will come vibrantly aglow with all your meaner greener vices at the fall of darkness. GREEN EYED MONSTER ​​is a milky white glow-in-the-dark lacquer filled with green shimmer that glows green in the dark. from the PANDORA UNBOXED SET. for best glow-in-the-dark results: give your bottle a little shake before applying. for the brightest glow, we recommend applying 3 coats. don’t skip your top coat. once you’re done painting, activate the glow by holding your nails under direct light for ~30 seconds. shut off the lights and prepare to fright. to recharge the glow effect, just hold your nails under direct light again. note: due to the highly-pigmented nature of this lacquer, its consistency will gradually grow thicker over time. when needed, simply add a few drops of nail polish thinner, to revitalize the formula.

Name: Hall of Mirrors
Description: CHAPTER VIII: A PALACE IN YOUR IMAGE. it’s time to leave a mark all your own. we’ve bottled the bits of our last shreds of hope into something spectacular. ornament all your favorite preexisting lacquers in a luxe coat of this glossy silver topper and you’ll create endless masterpieces anew. filled with sparkling silvery flakies, one glossy coat looks dazzling alone or can be used to instantly elevate any existing shade into a grandiose work of art worthy of hanging in versailles. HALL OF MIRRORS ​​is a glossy topper featuring silver flakies in a clear base. from the BAROQUEN SET. NOTE: due to the metallic nature of the flakies, it’s normal for this lacquer to appear gold in bottle + while it’s viewed in warm lighting or around warm tone objects (i.e. clothes, furniture, etc.).

Name: Hardcore Base Coat
Description: you’re not hardcore unless you live HARDCORE. so toughen tf up with our strengthening base coat. this garlic-infused growth serum will help set a few protective ground rules before you get lacquering. and, no, it doesn’t smell like garlic. but a few mooncats ~have~ reported the unconfirmed benefit of a decrease in the vampiric presences in their life after just one use. HARDCORE BASE COAT is a strengthening base coat. note: can be worn alone or under a layer of our GETTING EVEN NAIL PRIMER .

Name: Haunted Forest
Description: fearful whispers. this forest green jelly lacquer tells the tale of a watchful presence hidden beneath the boughs. iridescent flakies gleam like eyes peering in the night. HAUNTED FOREST is a forest green jelly lacquer filled with color-shifting iridescent flakies.

Name: Head In The Clouds
Description: PREPARE FOR DRIFT OFF. hey, MOONCATS, it’s your resident meteorologist here with your 10-day nail forecast. we’re heading into a cold front with mostly cloudy minds and a 100% chance of sudden shimmer showers. gear up for some very welcome turbulence with a lacquer that’s chock-full of shade. it’s just the dose of doom and gloom we’ve all been hoping for. now back to you, bob. HEAD IN THE CLOUDS is a cloud white lacquer filled with blue shimmer.

Name: Heart of Stone
Description: A THING OF PETRIFYING BEAUTY. color us lovestoned. because this sinister hex may be the only thing capable of melting our stonecold hearts. according to myth, this guileful gorgon will use near-constant glimmers of pink shimmer and holographic glitter to pull your gaze. only relenting once it has you fully immersed in a petrifyingly beautiful wave of pure stone. HEART OF STONE is a duochrome lacquer filled with holographic glitter that shifts between shades of stone and pink. from the MEDUSA UNLEASHED SET .

Name: Heart on a Platter
Description: LET EVERY EMOTION BLEED THROUGH. HEART ON A PLATTER is a deep red linear holographic shimmer lacquer. from the DANSE MACABRE SET . wear + care holographic flare appears in sunlight or direct light due to its richly pigmented nature, it’ll dry down semi-matte before top coat is applied finish with SPEED DEMON TOP COAT to enhance its shine, prevent chipping, + extend wear

Name: Heavenmetal
Description: FALLEN FROM ABOVE. bask in the perennial gloom of this sheer blue-white clawcoat. not every dark cloud has a holographic lining, but this one glitters and glows with an impending storm of blue shimmer and an avalanche of ULTRA-fine holographic glitter flakies that twinkle like a million shattered glass slippers. HEAVENMETAL is a sheer white lacquer filled with ULTRA-fine silver holographic glitter flakies and icy blue shimmer. from the BAND OF MISFITS SET . note: this shade has an intentionally ethereal sheerness, but can be layered to your liking over a coat of our GETTING EVEN NAIL PRIMER for a more opaque look.

Name: Heavy is the Crown Set
Description: THE THRONE IS ALL YOURS. as is the legacy you choose to leave. five holographic lacquers seek to advise you. and show just how multifaceted displays of strength, power, and influence can truly be. how will you dismantle the old world order and give rise to a new era of enlightenment and prosperity? your kingdom awaits. the HEAVY IS THE CROWN collection set includes five linear holographic lacquers: SHATTERED GLASS , a lilac shade, BOA CONSTRICTOR , a chocolate shade, ANTIFRAGILE , an indigo shade, VENUS FLYTRAP , a magenta shade, and NOT TODAY SATAN , a baby pink shade.

Name: Hell is Other People
Description: HEAVEN FOR A MISANTHROPE. HELL IS OTHER PEOPLE is a dark wine linear holographic lacquer filled with purple-pink shimmer. from the DANSE MACABRE SET . wear + care: holographic flare appears in sunlight or direct light due to its richly pigmented nature, it’ll dry down semi-matte before top coat is applied finish with SPEED DEMON TOP COAT to enhance its shine, prevent chipping, + extend wear

Name: Hermit Crab
Description: COME OUT OF YOUR SHELL - JUST A LITTLE BIT. and come and click. click. snap. snap. grab this. you don’t even have to leave your little sand burrow to get your claws on this suitably crabby brew. but when you inevitably do venture out, it’ll wrap your own tiny claws in a crustacean-like protective shell of coral color and golden flecks of iridescent flakies and shimmer. whether those gilded specks serve as a symbol for you breaking out of your little coral shell or further burrowing deeper into your cozy sandcastle, know that we support your journey. HERMIT CRAB is a coral jelly lacquer filled with iridescent flakies and orange shimmer. from the MERMAID TALES SET .

Name: High Fructose
Description: READY FOR A SUGAR RUSH? AHHHHH1HH!HH. sorry, this ULTRA sweet baby pink tincture has just got us amped up on life. sink your fangs into this delectable confection, and add a welcome dose of sweetener to your own day-to-day. filled with a corn syrupy dash of super chromey, XTRA color-shifty coral-to-yellow-to-blue-green shimmer, it’ll definitely satisfy all your claw cravings. HIGH FRUCTOSE is a baby pink lacquer filled with our XTRA shifty, super chromey shimmer that shifts dramatically from coral-to-yellow-to-blue-green as it’s viewed from different angles + in different lighting conditions. note: bc the appearance of our XTRA shifty shimmers changes dramatically under different lighting conditions, no one photo will truly capture its full appearance. we recommend viewing all photos to see the full range of its shifts.

Name: Highway Glow
Description: ROAD TO NOWHERE. you don’t need a destination in mind to wear this chartreuse creme lacquer. it gives off a soft, lustrous glow that beams like a headlight in the night. HIGHWAY GLOW is a vibrant chartreuse creme lacquer.

Name: House Of Hades
Description: FRESH FROM THE UNDERWORLD. grab your three-headed dog and fetch this real chill-inducing varnish, essential for any capsule clawdrobe. packed with icy glints of cool, cobalt ULTRA-fine flakies, that give off a ghost-like glow against an ominous purple-plum base unseen, this hotter-than-hades hue will help chauffeur your paws plainly into their underling era. HOUSE OF HADES is a deep blue-purple lacquer packed with cobalt ULTRA-fine flakies. from the UNDERWORLD SET . note: due to the highly-pigmented nature of this lacquer, its consistency will gradually grow thicker over time. when needed, simply add a few drops of nail polish thinner, to revitalize the formula.

Name: I'm a MF Supernova
Description: NOT TO BE DRAMATIC, BUT... this one has been known to make a scene wherever it goes. a sparkling vision in gold. adorned with impossible-to-miss holographic luster. watch as it burns out in spectacular, highly gratuitous fashion across the night sky. I’M A MF SUPERNOVA is a gold lacquer filled with holographic glitter.

Name: If Frogs Had Wings
Color(s): Gold, Green, Multichrome/Shift, Pink, Teal, Yellow
Description: IF IFS AND ANDS WERE POTS AND PANS… and pigs could fly, you’d find yourself bottled in an ethereal fantasyland… where the aqua dew is always dewier, and the bright pink water lilies are known to gloat beneath always sunny skies. it’s an enchanted retreat that’s perpetually buzzing with green and gold gossamer wings, and bubbling with an undercurrent of wondrous mischief. IF FROGS HAD WINGS is an aqua jelly lacquer filled with bright pink shimmer and soft yellow and green iridescent flakies. note: this shade looks most magical when viewed in the shade or overcast conditions.

Name: Illusionist
Description: she’s a magic maker. no, it’s not a trick of the eye–this mystical lacquer is shockingly real. the magnetic multichrome shifts from pink to orange to green to gold over a deep magnetic base. scattered gold holographic glitter electrifies the effect. ILLUSIONIST is a deep red magnetic multichrome lacquer filled with scattered gold holographic glitter that reveals a color-shifting pink-to-orange-to-green-to-gold stripe. for best results, use over of FROM THE ASHES

Name: Insomniac
Description: ARE YOU STILL AWAKE? because sleeping on this sweet lilac lacquer may just keep you up at night. with a lunar glow and a fully-caffeinated jolt of energy, it’ll feel right at home in your late-night lifestyle. a must for any nocturnal animal. INSOMNIAC is a lilac creme lacquer. from the TECHNICOLOR DREAMS collection.

Name: Into The Abyss
Description: WHAT LURKS BEYOND THE SHADOWS? venture fearlessly into the unknown with a deep midnight creme lacquer filled with uncharted mystery. INTO THE ABYSS is a deep midnight blue creme lacquer.

Name: Into The Wishing Well
Color(s): Gold, Green, Multichrome/Shift, Pink, Purple, Yellow
Description: AS YOU WISH. close your eyes. make a wish. and toss your most closely held fancies into existence aback glittering pieces of gold, watching as your wishes tumble through this enchanted periwinkle pool, rippling with electrified green, pink, and yellow hints of your soon-to-be manifested magic. INTO THE WISHING WELL is a deep periwinkle lacquer filled with micro holographic glitter and bright pink, soft yellow, and electric green iridescent shimmer.

Name: Jasmine Dragon
Description: ONE OF LIFE’S TRUE DELIGHTS. JASMINE DRAGON is a bright orange magnetic lacquer filled with color-shifting, iridescent yellow-to-orange-to-green flakies and red glitter, that reveals a burnt orange base when magnetized. from our AVATAR: THE LAST AIRBENDER collaboration collection - and only available for a limited time. wear + care: features a limited-edition firebending bottle design with a special gold cap + a limited-edition FIRE NATION carton note: this item only ships to the US and CANADA. © 2025 Viacom International Inc.

Name: Jewel Beetle
Description: CELEBRATE THIS SZN OF CHANGE. should you be lucky enough to catch sight of this transformative tincture in the wild, nestled in the spruces, firs, or hemlocks, consider it your sign that a new chapter is on the horizon. as it crawls endlessly between chromey shades of pink and gold and green – and back again – let it fuel your own personal transformation and remind you, no matter where you are, of how far you’ve already come. JEWEL BEETLE is a multichrome lacquer that shifts between shades of pink, gold, and green as it’s viewed from different angles. from the FALLEN SET .

Name: Jump Jump Bug
Description: 跳跳蟲 | UNBOTTLE YOUR IMAGINATION. hop. hop. hop. and nestle your claws deep within your imagination, where you may just catch a sight of this silly little thermal creature, endlessly hop, skip, jumping between shades of medium jade, when cold, and light green, when warm. JUMP JUMP BUG is a green thermal lacquer that transitions from a shade of medium jade green when cold to a shade of light celadon green when warm. from the REMEDY SET . note: due to the nature of the special pigments used, this lacquer will have a thicker formula. it may also cause some separation to occur in bottle. this is normal + won’t affect the application or finish. simply shake well before each use. how a thermal lacquer looks + transitions may vary based on your body chemistry, room conditions, + current climate. it can take up to a few hours for the color transitioning effect to be activated for the first time. applying a base coat + finishing this shade with SPEED DEMON TOP COAT is required to prevent chipping + prolong its wear.

Name: Kafkaesque
Description: THE SHADE OF POETIC CHAOS. i cannot make you understand. i cannot make anyone understand what’s happening inside me. but if you unspool this deep brown labyrinth–the perfect mix of the absurd, the surreal, and the mundane–you, too, may suddenly find your claws inexplicably transformed… what a delightfully nightmarish fate to condemn your paws to. KAFKAESQUE is a deep brown creme lacquer. from the A TALE OF 5 LACQUERS SET .

Name: Kattermanjaro
Description: UNBELIEVABLY HOT. KATTERMANJARO is a neon hot pink glow-in-the-dark lacquer filled with subtle pink shimmer that glows peach in the dark. From the PLANET NYARR SET . Wear + Care: For the brightest, peachiest glow, we recommend applying 3 coats Due to the highly-pigmented nature of this lacquer, its consistency will gradually grow thicker over time Simply add a few drops of LACQUER REVITALIZER , to revive its consistency How to Use: Glow pigments will settle in bottle when not in use. Give your bottle a shake before applying To activate glow effect, hold your nails under direct light for at least 30 seconds before shutting off the lights Your light source can affect glow strength + glow color. Charge with sunlight for the strongest glow

Name: Kelp Kingdom
Description: A FORGOTTEN EMPIRE FOUND. what’s that lurking in the deep? flip on your headlamp and drift through the moss covered mysteries of this reflective magnetic realm, where glittering jewels and otherworldly creatures abound. KELP KINGDOM is a rich moss green magnetic multichrome lacquer filled with reflective glitter that reveals a color-shifting blush-to-gold stripe. from the EXPEDITION: ATLANTIS set. A NOTE FOR SMOOTH SAILS: reflective magnetic lacquers are highly textured and should be finished with 1-2 layers of our SPEED DEMON TOP COAT . note: all orders with magnetic lacquers include one free magnetic wand .

Name: Koi Whiskers
Description: 鯉鬚 | LIKE SPLASHES FROM A FISH CAT. treat yourself to a slice of calm with the everchanging scenes of this temperature-reactive, figurative koi pond. gliding in slow motion, with soft pink scale-like shimmer, it will flutter from coral orange, when cold, to pastel yellow, when warm. KOI WHISKERS is a coral-to-yellow thermal lacquer filled with soft pink shimmer that transitions from a shade of coral orange when cold to a shade of pastel yellow when warm. from the REMEDY SET . note: due to the nature of the special pigments used, this lacquer will have a thicker formula. it may also cause some separation to occur in bottle. this is normal + won’t affect the application or finish. simply shake well before each use. how a thermal lacquer looks + transitions may vary based on your body chemistry, room conditions, + current climate. it can take up to a few hours for the color transitioning effect to be activated for the first time. applying a base coat + finishing this shade with SPEED DEMON TOP COA T is required to prevent chipping + prolong its wear.

Name: La Petite Mort
Description: CHAPTER IV: A MOMENT OF TRANSCENDENCE. drawn together by an unshakable magnetism. a crescendoing climax of kaleidoscopic splendor, in stifled gasps of cold blue. flush with pink pangs of iridescence. fluttering with sudden rushes of color in gold, green, and blue. overcome with holographic shivers of shimmer. faint of heart. forever magnetized by the sparkling silver glimmer of an otherworldly pull. a taste of the immortal, already fleeting. LA PETITE MORT is a light blue magnetic lacquer filled with holo shimmer, iridescent flakies, and holo glitter that reveals a silver magnetic stripe. from the BAROQUEN SET .

Name: Lacquer Revitalizer
Description: IN NEED OF A REVIVAL? breathe new life into your favorite lacquers and restore their consistency with just a few drops of our LACQUER REVITALIZER. high-quality lacquers, like ours, are packed with rich, high-quality pigments so that they always have the most impactful effects and vibrancy possible. because of this, and factors like how much lacquers are exposed to air, and temperature shifts, it’s natural for lacquers to thicken up over time. just a few drops of our nail lacquer thinner will help revitalize the remainder of all your beloved lacquer bottles’ consistency without diluting their vibrancy. DIRECTIONS: use sparingly. add 2-3 drops of LACQUER REVITALIZER to your nail lacquer bottle. shake well. test the nail lacquer on your nail. repeat steps until your desired consistency is achieved. our LACQUER REVITALIZER is a nail lacquer thinner designed to revive your favorite lacquers’ original consistency. can be used in all our lacquers, top, and base coats. only ships to the contiguous US. note: this product has a strong scent. please keep closed when not in use.

Name: Lacquer Set
Description: WATER. EARTH. FIRE. AIR. the AVATAR: THE LAST AIRBENDER collaboration collection set includes 8 special effect lacquers, THE AVATAR STATE , SPIRIT WATER , BLOODBENDER , MY CABBAGES! , TALES OF BA SING SE , BANISHED PRINCE , JASMINE DRAGON , and BREATH OF WIND . all only available for a limited time. all orders with magnetic lacquers include one free magnetic wand. wear + care: each lacquer features a limited-edition AVATAR: THE LAST AIRBENDER bottle design with a special gold cap + a limited-edition carton note: this item only ships to the US and CANADA. © 2025 Viacom International Inc.

Name: Lava Lamp
Description: ENLIGHTEN YOURSELF. take it s l o w. and let this soothing jade shade be a light in even the most totally uncool of days, as iridescent flakies slowly float through a relaxing wave of teal, blue, and yellow hues. you may just discover that watching paint dry can actually be pretty t r i p p y, man. LAVA LAMP is a jade jelly lacquer filled with teal, blue, and yellow iridescent flakies. its buildable formula can be layered to your liking, for either a semi-sheer or more opaque look.

Name: Light of Your Ninth Life
Description: RELEASE THE INHIBITIONS OF LIVES PAST. LIGHT OF YOUR NINTH LIFE is an orange glow-in-the-dark lacquer filled with green shimmer that glows orange in the dark. From the PLANET NYARR SET . Wear + Care: For the brightest glow, we recommend applying 3 coats Due to the highly-pigmented nature of this lacquer, its consistency will gradually grow thicker over time Simply add a few drops of LACQUER REVITALIZER , to revive its consistency How to Use: Glow pigments will settle in bottle when not in use. Give your bottle a shake before applying To activate glow effect, hold your nails under direct light for at least 30 seconds before shutting off the lights Your light source can affect glow strength + glow color. Charge with sunlight for the strongest glow

Name: Like A Moth To A Flame
Description: TRY NOT TO GET PULLED IN. called by an inner yearning something still burning like a moth to a flame my ashen gray wings are only sent aflutter by fleeting things like the red-to-orange-to-green flickering of embers slowly tickering like a moth to a flame LIKE A MOTH TO A FLAME is a smokey gray lacquer filled with color-shifting red-orange-green shimmer. from the MY INNER APOCALYPSE: AN EP FOR EXISTENTIAL DAYS SET .

Name: Litterbox
Description: YOUR OWN PRIVATE, ULTRA-SPARKLY OASIS. LITTERBOX is a baby pink glitter lacquer jam-packed with holographic glitter and reflective glitter. From the PLANET NYARR SET . Wear + Care: Due to the highly-pigmented nature of this lacquer, its consistency will gradually grow thicker over time. Simply add a few drops of LACQUER REVITALIZER , to revive its consistency How to use: For maximum opacity, use multiple short, dab-like brush strokes per coat. Allow it to dry fully between coats. This lacquer will dry textured. Top with SPEED DEMON TOP COAT for a smooth, glossy finish. Holographic flare appears in sunlight or direct light Reflective sparkle appears under camera/phone flash + very bright direct light

Name: Loch Ness
Description: the legend is real. this holographic lacquer transforms in front of your eyes, as the electric navy blue base morphs to reveal the entirety of the rainbow spectrum. see it for yourself to believe it. LOCH NESS is a navy blue linear holographic lacquer. formerly known as LARKSPUR note: holographic lacquers look best in the sunlight or under a direct light, where they reveal their full rainbow effect. in the shade or overcast conditions, the effect will be more muted (but still mesmerizing).

Name: Long-Lasting Essentials Duo
Description: SUMMON IMMACULATE CLAWS. make the most of every mani by starting and ending your routine with this pair of long-lasting must-haves: our smoothing base coat and glossy, quick-drying top coat. get these claw heroes to team up, and they’ll put a powerful hex on chips, breaks, and general bad vibes. the LONG-LASTING ESSENTIALS DUO includes our GETTING EVEN NAIL PRIMER , a lightly tinted ridge-filling base coat, and SPEED DEMON TOP COAT , a glossy, quick-drying top coat.

Name: Lost In A Folktale Set
Description: FOLLOW US INTO THE ENCHANTED WOOD… …where, nestled deep within the sprawling thicket and hollow, plucked straight from the pages of woodland folklore, six enchanted special effect lacquers have been known to flutter and fly by. catch sight of one of these ever-shifting shimmers and flakies, or dew-crested magnetics, and you’ll truly begin to see what wondrous whimsy is adrift in this fantasy fairyland. the LOST IN A FOLKTALE SET includes 6 special-effect lacquers in a range of finishes: PIXIESTICK , WEEPING WILLOW , FLIGHT OF THE MONARCHS , SHROOMDOM , STUMPED , and POISONBERRY .

Name: Lost Polaroids
Description: FROZEN IN TIME AND LONG SINCE FORGOTTEN. rediscover buried summer memories with this vibrant fuchsia creme lacquer. LOST POLAROIDS is a vibrant fuchsia creme lacquer.

Name: Love's Labyrinth
