Description: CHAPTER III: A MOST PUZZLING PARADISE. lost in the electrifying maze of their green-eyed gaze. while their words meander like seemingly serene sage green flourishes of fiction. each a carefully constructed wall, to hedge their bets, truncating a once lush green painted paradise. clawing towards the exit, but again blinded by the holographic rainbow spectrum of their essence. cursed to forever wander in this most hypnotic labyrinth. LOVE’S LABYRINTH is a light sage green linear holographic lacquer. from the BAROQUEN SET .

Name: Lovebomb
Description: DON’T TICK US OFF. we’ve mashed up every empty promise, every deceitful trick, every vacant display of affection, so you can drench your claw and throw all your bottled pangs right back like a blistering boomerang. like a thousand unwanted hits of eros’ arrow, this potent potion is overwhelmingly overloaded with infuriating bursts of the most hypnotic pops of micro holographic glitter. once they dissipate, and dispel every hauntingly hollow transfixion, it’ll only emit the most-swoon-inducing violet glow, an inescapable warmth, in the never-wafting wake of this soothing mauvey pink shade. LOVEBOMB is a mauve lacquer filled with violet shimmer and micro holographic glitter. from the SEASONS OF PERSEPHONE SET .

Name: Lucid Dream
Description: YOU’RE NOW ENTERING THE UNCANNY VALLEY. where everything feels...just...ever so slightly...unright. as you find yourself floating semi-consciously through the all-too-vibrant peachy coral ridges of this otherworldly dreamscape, just know that this serene creme lacquer is a totem of reality that you can always come back to. LUCID DREAM is a peachy coral creme lacquer. from the TECHNICOLOR DREAMS collection.

Name: Lust for Vengeance
Description: REVENGE LOOKS GOOD ON YOU. love to hate? sharpen your claws and suit up for all your necessary evils with, what’s quite possibly, the universe’s cutest claw armor. its seemingly demure, deep pink base is galvanized by an electrifying green pang of iridescent shimmer that’ll help propel you forward to face all your devious yearnings, self-righteous ruminations, inevitable evildoings. LUST FOR VENGEANCE is a deep pink lacquer filled with green shimmer. from the PANDORA UNBOXED SET .

Name: Maelstrom
Description: WEATHER THE STORM. dip your claws into a most spectacular vortex. legend has it that this deep blue-green beauty is swirling with the crushed remnants of a thousand ill-intentioned vessels – disorienting eddies of ever-shifting green and yellow iridescent flakies and finely ground holographic glitter. brave the blue if you dare. for maybe you, too, will merely add to the whirl of its ever growing beauty… MAELSTROM is a deep blue-green jelly lacquer filled with color-shifting green-to-yellow iridescent flakies and micro holographic glitter. from the SONGS OF SIRENS SET .

Name: Malevolent
Description: REVEAL A SINISTER STREAK. want to wear your cold, black heart on your sleeve? just dip your claws into this magnetizing potion. as you wield your wand you’ll begin to slowly uncover glimmers of your most ominous intentions, unearthing nefarious purple-to-pink hints of your most sinister, ever-shifting ambitions and holographic glints of your darkest desires. MALEVOLENT is a black magnetic lacquer filled with gold holographic glitter that reveals a purple-to-pink multichrome magnetic stripe. note: all orders with magnetic lacquers include one free magnetic wand . this is CONTINUUM 2.0. WARNING: this product can expose you to chemicals including chromium, which is known to the state of CALIFORNIA to cause cancer and reproductive harm. for more information visit www.p65warnings.ca.gov

Name: Manchineel Tree
Description: BEWARE OF THE TREES. MANCHINEEL TREE is a neon green solar lacquer filled with orange shimmer that reveals subtle orange undertones in its sun-activated state. from the DEADLY BY NATURE SET . wear + care: solar lacquer changes color in sunlight strong UV creates a more intense shift, while low UV results in a subtler change color change intensity and duration may vary with temperature color change effect may diminish over time designed and tested for compatibility with SPEED DEMON TOP COAT

Name: Matte Made in Hell
Description: IF YOU CAN’T SUMMON THE LACQUERS OF HELL DIRECTLY, STORE-BOUGHT IS FINE. bottled fresh from the infernal springs, this devilishly smooth matte top coat will have an instantly bewitching effect on all of your dearly beloved mooncat pigments. it may just have you selling your own soul. after all, you and this one are a true matte made in hell. <3 MATTE MADE IN HELL is a matte top coat.

Name: Melonberry
Description: 瓜莓 | THE FRUITS OF OUR OVERACTIVE IMAGINATIONS. inspired by silly, school-age doodles, this whimsical shade fuses the essence of our two favorite cats, watermelon and blueberry, in one temperature-reactive hue. tap into your coldest plans, and you’ll harness a blueberry-esque purple coat, and at your fieriest, your claws will turn a watermelon-approved pink. occupy the in between, and a dueling meld of purple-pink will, fittingly, emerge. MELONBERRY is a purple-pink thermal lacquer that transitions from a shade of lilac purple when cold to a shade of light pink when warm. from the REMEDY SET . note: due to the nature of the special pigments used, this lacquer will have a thicker formula. it may also cause some separation to occur in bottle. this is normal + won’t affect the application or finish. simply shake well before each use. how a thermal lacquer looks + transitions may vary based on your body chemistry, room conditions, + current climate. it can take up to a few hours for the color transitioning effect to be activated for the first time. applying a base coat + finishing this shade with SPEED DEMON TOP COAT is required to prevent chipping + prolong its wear.

Name: Memento Mori
Description: ACCEPT THIS GRIM REALITY. let this bone-ivory shade serve as a beautiful reminder to relish all that is finite. packed with an ever-glimmering burst of fiery orange shimmer, this seemingly demure shade will forever flicker, like a slow-melting candle or the crawl of sunset, reminding you, endlessly, to bask in the ever-fleeting present. MEMENTO MORI is an ivory lacquer filled with orange shimmer. from the FALLEN SET .

Name: Meowtek Industries
Description: SMILE - THEY’RE ALWAYS, ALWAYS… WATCHING. MEOWTEK INDUSTRIES is a multichrome lacquer that shifts between shades of green and purple as it’s viewed from different angles. from the WELCOME TO PARADISE SET .

Name: Mercury in Retrograde
Description: SUMMON A LITTLE COSMIC CHAOS. is mercury in retrograde? maybe. or maybe you’re just picking up the ~vibes~ of this shade of celestial chaos. unbottle this mischievous periwinkle blue brew and you may just unleash a disorienting burst of pink shimmer and a silver-y magnetic trail of trouble across your own slice of the galaxy. how will that magnetic mischief manifest? well, that’s up to you (and the cosmos) to decide. wave your magnetic wand and watch as a few wicked cat eyes or velvety incantations quickly come to fruition. communication breakdowns, technological troubles, and relationship strife not included. MERCURY IN RETROGRADE is a periwinkle blue magnetic lacquer filled with pink shimmer that reveals a silver magnetic stripe.

Name: Mercury's Tears
Description: get immersed in the ever shifting tides. release the constraints holding you back. MERCURY'S TEARS is a cobalt blue lacquer filled with color-shifting green and pink shimmer. disclaimer: note: this shade looks most magical when viewed in the shade or overcast conditions.

Name: Merkitten
Description: MEET THE GALAXY’S FAVORITE PURRMAID. me-ow. looks like you just found yourself the shore’s shiniest little seashell - a purrr-plexingly hot pink specimen sparkling with an ice-cold wash of briny-blue iridescent shimmer and the teeniest, tiniest super micro holographic-iest glimmering glitter scales. take your paws for a dip in this cosmic shade of sylphy chicness, and it’ll light your claws up like the cutest little pairs of electric pink fins. MERKITTEN is a sheer hot pink jelly lacquer filled with blue shimmer and super micro holographic glitter. from the MERMAID TALES SET . note: this shade has an intentionally ethereal sheerness, but can be layered to your liking over a coat of our GETTING EVEN NAIL PRIMER for a more opaque look.

Name: Mermaid Bait
Description: THIS ONE ALWAYS MAKES A SPLASH. get em hook, line, + sinker with this lacquered lure of lore. like a sweet siren’s song, this turquoise tincture cycles through an XTRA shifty, super chromey wave of pink-to-gold-to-lime green melodies that’ll leave your preferred prey positively transfixed. just try not to get too distracted yourself. MERMAID BAIT is a turquoise lacquer filled with our XTRA shifty, super chromey shimmer that shifts dramatically from pink-to-gold-to-lime green, giving this shade a baby blue appearance in the sun and a greener appearance in the shade. note: bc the appearance of our XTRA shifty shimmers changes dramatically under different lighting conditions, no one photo will truly capture its full appearance. we recommend viewing all photos to see the full range of its shifts.

Name: Mermaid Tales Set
Description: TAKE THE BAIT. wade into troubled waters with 6 suitably splashy NEW mermessages in a bottle - just-surfaced ballads from the saltiest flakies, shimmers, + ULTRA-fine flakies in the whole deep blue sea. let them reel you in, + each sparkling shade will perpetually pull you twenty thousand leagues deeper…+ deeper… under their spell. the MERMAID TALES SET includes 6 special effect lacquers: CATFISHED , MERKITTEN , BERMUDA TRIANGLE , MOONJELLY , PLANKTON , and HERMIT CRAB .

Name: Midnight Drive
Description: BLAZE YOUR OWN PATH. take your claws for a wild ride - and let this ULTRAvibrant violet shade underscore your late-night mischief like an electric mixtape. where you go is up to you. but wherever you’re headed, you’ll undoubtedly go BOLDLY. MIDNIGHT DRIVE is a vibrant violet creme lacquer. note: when used alone, this lacquer will dry matte. we recommend topping it with our SPEED DEMON TOP COAT for a glossy, long-lasting finish.

Name: Midnight Rider
Description: MEOWDY, MOON PARTNER. you don’t have to run all over hell’s half acre to get a little ~space~... we lassoed the stars for you - little holographic glints of spacedust - and set them off to dance against a night-sky-like blue base. whenever you can use a slice of pensive quiet, simply sink your spurs into this ever-shifting slice of black-to-blue twilight. MIDNIGHT RIDER is a midnight blue multichrome lacquer filled with micro holographic glitter, that shifts between shades of black and blue as it’s viewed from different angles. from the MIDNIGHT RODEO SET .

Name: Midnight Rodeo Set
Description: DUST OFF YOUR BOOTS an outlaw has emerged - ten to be exact. a notorious band of lacquers - the most-wanted matte topper, multichrome glitter, shimmers, + matte flakies in all of the galaxy - each fixin’ to have your claws in a frenzy. trail em… trot out to the most desolate slice of the dusk-soaked desert valley + lasso this prickly palette into your own home on the range. the MIDNIGHT RODEO SET includes 10 nail lacquers, 9 special effect shades + 1 topper: OUTLAW COUNTRY , DARK HORSE , MOONRISE , MIDNIGHT RIDER , WHEN THE DEVIL STRIKES , SAND VIPER , PRICKLY PEAR , WHISKEY SUNRISE , BOOTLEGGER , and FOOL’S GOLD .

Name: Millennia
Description: Prepare to be catapulted into the unknown! make infinite designs — the possibilities are endless. MILLENNIA is a magnetic multichrome lacquer that shifts between shades of violet, blue, and green with green-gold scattered holographic glitter. for best results, use over one coat of EMO FOR LIFE

Name: Misery Is My Favorite Color
Description: BECAUSE IT’S PERFECT FOR EVERY SHADE OF SORROW. this is my favorite color an endless pool of deep slate, dense with heavy tear-like drops this is my favorite color lit with electric blue shimmer like lightning-cloud pops this is my favorite color like an inescapable gloom you can’t help but swallow in this is my favorite color like a thrashing wave you can’t help but wallow in MISERY IS MY FAVORITE COLOR is a slate blue lacquer filled with electric blue shimmer. from the MY INNER APOCALYPSE: AN EP FOR EXISTENTIAL DAYS SET .

Name: Molten Lava
Description: THIS LACQUER IS LAVA. heat things up with this hot hot matte coral orange lacquer. uncap this volcanic shade and let a sizzZZZling burst of color-shifting red-to-coral-to-orange ULTRA-fine flakies and hot pink reflective glitter flow over your claws. it’ll leave nothing but an igneous rock solid burst of fiery matte color behind. MOLTEN LAVA is a matte coral orange lacquer jam-packed with color-shifting red-to-coral-to-orange ULTRA-fine flakies and reflective glitter. from the PRETTY PREHISTORIC SET . finish with a coat of MATTE MADE IN HELL to lock in your look, prolong your wear, + help this shade really pop. \not a matte fan? just top this shade w SPEED DEMON TOP COAT for a glossy finish.

Name: Momo Yuyake
Description: 桃夕焼け | LIKE AN ANIME SKY. scenes from the nights we raced for our rooftops. when vibrant waves of coral-peach pink crept over the bluest sky. and the juiciest clouds, ripe with ever-changing pops of peach, pink, and yellow, looked like giant floating momos wading over the fading day... MOMO YUYAKE is a vibrant coral pink lacquer filled with color-shifting peach-to-pink-to-orange shimmer. from the REMEDY SET .

Name: Monster Under Your Head
Description: KNOCK, KNOCK. WHO’S SCARED? you’re just mistaken you’ve just taken this creepycrawly dark olive shadow creature as the namesake in an autobiographical horror feature awaken the things that go bump in the night meet your monster in the light and see every arc of its true rainbow holographic splendor alight what a hauntingly beautiful sight MONSTER UNDER YOUR HEAD is a dark olive green linear holographic lacquer. from the MY INNER APOCALYPSE: AN EP FOR EXISTENTIAL DAYS SET .

Name: Mood Ring
Description: LOOKS LIKE YOU’RE FEELING… G R O O V Y. spur endless good vibes with this psychedelic purple lacquer. yeah, it might flicker between iridescent glints of your simmering pink passion and occasionally blue mood… but that’s life, man. and life’s pretty a l r i g h t. MOOD RING is a purple jelly lacquer filled with turquoise and pink iridescent flakies. its buildable formula can be layered to your liking, for either a semi-sheer or more opaque look. from the KALEIDOSCOPE HAZE SET .

Name: Moondust
Description: MOONDUST illuminates the dark side. this clear topper is filled with silver micro holographic glitter. it adds a scattering of light to any lacquer you layer underneath, and has a subtle magic when worn all alone. MOONDUST is a clear topper filled with holographic glitter.

Name: Moonfairy
Description: SET YOUR HEART AFLUTTER. with an enchanted concoction that’s equal parts wraith, lust, and pixie dust. uncap this twinkling pink-lavender lacquer and unleash your own ever-so-deviant dash of storybook magic. and try not to be charmed as this lunar sprite’s soft butterfly wings glitter and glow through sparkling shades of pink, yellow, and teal at the first fall of moonlight. MOONFAIRY is a pink-lavender jelly lacquer filled with yellow, pink, and teal iridescent flakies, indigo shimmer, and micro holographic glitter. note: this shade looks most magical when viewed in the shade or overcast conditions.

Name: Moonflower
Description: SOURCED DIRECT FROM OUTER SPACE. everything’s coming up rainbows. pluck this galactic bloom and see for yourself. wield a few flecks of this otherworldly silver blossom in the sun and it’ll unleash an extraterrestrial arc of holographic rainbow magic that’s positively out of this world MOONFLOWER is a silver linear holographic lacquer. note: holographic lacquers look best in the sunlight or under a direct light, where they reveal their full rainbow effect. in the shade or overcast conditions, the effect will be more muted (but still mesmerizing).

Name: Moonicorn
Description: FROM SOMEWHERE OVER THE MOONBOW… one part extraterrestrial. two parts sugarcandymagicmystery. the bright side of the moon is where this mystical light lilac clawcoat calls home. perma-fluttering with an enchanting green lunar glow, this storied creature is known to leave a trail of glimmering rainbow-like, micro holographic glitter wherever it goes. MOONICORN is a light lilac lacquer filled with green shimmer and micro holographic glitter. from the BAND OF MISFITS SET .

Name: Moonjelly
Description: CUTE BUT VENOMOUS. look at this little one go. missing it from your clawdrobe would surely sting. with a semi translucent white base, that glitters and glows with electric pops of blue shimmer and blue-to-green-to-purple-to-pink flakies, this little jelly will help turn your claws into fluttering tentacles all your own. MOONJELLY is a sheer white jelly lacquer filled with color-shifting blue-to-green-to-purple-to-pink iridescent flakies, bright blue shimmer, and super micro holographic glitter. from the MERMAID TALES SET .

Name: Moonlight Lullaby
Description: ILLUMINATE EVEN THE DARKEST NIGHT. MOONLIGHT LULLABY is an icy white glow-in-the-dark lacquer with blue undertones and white shimmer that glows white in the dark. wear + care: for the brightest glow, we recommend applying 3 coats due to the highly-pigmented nature of this lacquer, its consistency will gradually grow thicker over time simply add a few drops of LACQUER REVITALIZER , to revive its consistency how to use: give your bottle a shake before applying to activate glow effect, hold your nails under direct light for ~30 seconds before shutting off the lights

Name: Moonrise
Description: WATERMELON, WE’RE NOT IN NASHVILLE ANYMORE… take your paws somewhere over the moonbow - where the clouds glitter and glow like puffs of holo and the dawn is marked by the brightest cotton-candy skies. with a coat of this cosmic dreamscape, your claws will wake up with the cheer of a sheer wave of sunset pink, an uncanny burst of sky blue iridescent shimmer, and holographic ULTRA-fine glitter flakies and micro holo, that flutter against the rising moonglow like folded wings. MOONRISE is a sheer pink jelly lacquer filled with ULTRA-fine holographic glitter flakies, blue shimmer, and micro holographic glitter. from the MIDNIGHT RODEO SET . note: this shade has an intentionally ethereal sheerness for optimal glowiness, but can be layered to your liking over GETTING EVEN NAIL PRIMER for maximum opacity.

Name: Moonwalk
Description: REWARD YOURSELF W A MISFITS-EXCLUSIVE LACQUER. prepare your claws for lift-off with a rewards-exclusive lilac lacquer that’ll shuttle your paws through a galaxy’s-worth of color-shifting pink-to-gold iridescent ULTRA-fine flakies and micro holo glitter. only available to members of THE MISFITS CLUB - now through the end of the year. MOONWALK is a lilac reward lacquer jam-packed with color-shifting pink-to-gold iridescent ULTRA-fine flakies and micro holo glitter. only available for reward redemption in THE MISFITS CLUB. need a little time to earn some extra points? no worries. we’ll continue to restock MOONWALK through the end of the year, to the best of our ability.

Name: Moral Decay
Description: LONG LIVE THE ALGORITHM. MORAL DECAY is a dark green to teal thermal lacquer that transitions from a shade of dark green-black when cold to bright teal when warm. from the WELCOME TO PARADISE SET . wear + care: thermal effects may vary based on body chemistry, temperature, + climate formula tends to be thicker due to the special pigments used color shift may take a few hours to activate initially use a base coat + speed demon top coat to prevent chipping + extend wear

Name: Mortals be Warned
Description: FOOLISH MORTALS. we were never alone. the malevolent forces from beyond are finally ready to make their presence known. and tonight marks the eve of eternal war. as an ominous wave of berry saucers slowly but steadily descend from an apocalyptic indigo sky, consider this your final warning for what’s surely to come. MORTALS BE WARNED is a multichrome lacquer that shifts between shades of indigo and berry as it’s viewed from different angles.

Name: Murraya's Melody
Description: 七里香的旋律 | DELICATE BUT IMPOSSIBLE TO FORGET. bask in the everfleeting feeling of the sunniest day. as this pastel yellow stretches across your claws, they’ll blossom with shimmering pulses of yellow-green whose glimmer may even linger with you long after its last lacquered petals remain. MURRAYA’S MELODY is a semi-sheer pastel yellow lacquer filled with color-shifting yellow-to-green shimmer. from the REMEDY SET . note: this shade has an intentionally ethereal sheerness, but can be layered to your liking over a coat of our GETTING EVEN NAIL PRIMER for a more opaque look.

Name: Mutiny
Description: YOUR REBOOT HAS BEEN INITIATED. MUTINY is a lime green magnetic lacquer that reveals a deep teal base when magnetized. from the WELCOME TO PARADISE SET .

Name: My Cabbages!
Description: MY CABBAGES! MY CABBAGES! is a green flakie lacquer jam-packed with iridescent flakies that shift from green to yellow to orange. from our AVATAR: THE LAST AIRBENDER collaboration collection - and only available for a limited time. wear + care: features a limited-edition earthbending bottle design with a special gold cap + a limited-edition EARTH KINGDOM carton note: this item only ships to the US and CANADA. © 2025 Viacom International Inc.

Name: Nail Elixir
Description: CONJURE CUTICLE CLARITY. looking for a little practical magic? summoning this antioxidant-rich mix of marula oil, jojoba oil, argan oil, and vitamin E, at least 2x per day will keep your paws, claws, and cuticles looking positively on point. wanna put a hex on hangnails and stay hydrated? just apply a coat of NAIL ELIXIR. wanna know a hack to help prevent breakage? pst - it’s applying NAIL ELIXIR. looking for the best way to promote nail growth? you guessed it - ding. ding. - it’s also regular use of NAIL ELIXIR. our NAIL ELIXIR is an antioxidant-rich nail + cuticle oil, made with a luxe blend of marula oil, vitamin E, argan oil, and jojoba oil.

Name: Nail Essentials Set
Description: SO YOU WANT TO DABBLE IN THE ARTS? consider this set of MOONCAT essentials the ultimate at-home mani kit. no matter what kind of nail hijinks you’re looking to get into, this set has everything you need to ensure your cuticles, claws, and little lacquered works of nail art stay looking flawless. the NAIL ESSENTIALS SET includes a SHAPESHIFTER , our crystal nail file, a BOUNDARY PUSHER , our crystal cuticle pusher, THE VANISHER , a clean-up brush, NAIL ELIXIR , our luxe nail + cuticle oil, HARDCORE BASE COAT , our strengthening base, SPEED DEMON TOP COAT , our glossy, quick-dry finishing layer.

Name: Neptune's Sand
Description: WARM RAYS OF SUN AND GOLDEN SANDS. this rose gold lacquer is like a treasure from distant lands. watch this lacquer gleam in the light to capture a bit of that magic for yourself. NEPTUNE’S SAND is a rose gold magnetic lacquer filled with gold holographic glitter that reveals a gold stripe. note: all orders with magnetic lacquers include one free magnetic wand .

Name: Neverland
Description: GET LOST. leave the grown up world behind and retreat to a realm of endless adventure. immerse yourself in this verdant baby lime isle and you may just find yourself overcome with the magic of pixie dust and a promise to never fully grow up. NEVERLAND is a baby lime creme lacquer. from the TECHNICOLOR DREAMS collection.

Name: Night Owl Set
Description: A TRUE DREAM. for those who lie sleepless under the light of a wayward moon, we bring a set of five essential creme lacquers, each one so dreamy, they’ll carry you swiftly into far-off realms. the NIGHT OWL SET includes five cremes: SWEET NIGHTMARE , a periwinkle lacquer, INSOMNIAC , a lilac lacquer, MIDNIGHT DRIVE , a vibrant violet lacquer, QUEEN OF CHAOS , a regal amethyst lacquer, and EMO FOR LIFE , a rich, black lacquer.

Name: Nightbreak
Description: TWILIGHT MADE ETERNAL. NIGHTBREAK is a light lavender purple metallic lacquer. from the BAND OF MISFITS II SET – and available for a limited time.

Name: Nightcrawler
Description: ENTICE EVERY VICE. bug out and feed your shadow urges lurking in plain sight bug out and let your tendrils sink into smashed bunches of this dark smokey purple nectar-like delight plucked straight from a devilish vine mashed into something wine-stained and wholly undivine NIGHTCRAWLER is a dark smokey gray-purple lacquer filled with soft purple shimmer. from the MY INNER APOCALYPSE: AN EP FOR EXISTENTIAL DAYS SET .

Name: Nightmode
Description: I AM DARKNESS. NIGHTMODE is a blue-purple metallic holographic lacquer. from the WELCOME TO PARADISE SET . wear + care: holographic flare appears in sunlight or direct light appears more metallic in the shade or overcast conditions

Name: Nirvana Pro X
Description: YOUR FINAL UPGRADE. NIRVANA PRO X is a multichrome flakie lacquer packed with color-shifting silver to pink to green flakies. from the WELCOME TO PARADISE SET . wear + care: for maximum opacity, use multiple short, dab-like brush strokes per coat due to the nature of this flakie-packed formula, it may take slightly longer to dry allow it to dry fully between coats + finish with speed demon top coat apply 1 coat to wear as a topper, 3 coats for full opacity

Name: Nocturne
Description: LIKE A PAINTED NIGHT. unbottle this truly transformative tincture and summon endless works of evocative art. will this dusky dark teal hue, flecked with bronze flakies, stir visions of fireworks against a fog-covered night or the twinkle of something celestial far beyond… will you harness its magnetic magic to conjure a fiery horizon line or a velvety copper-orange cloud, like the embers of a rocket long gone? no matter what you create, and no matter what the critics might say, we know you’ll conjure something truly one of a kind. NOCTURNE is a dusky, dark teal green magnetic lacquer with bronze flakies that reveals a copper-orange magnetic stripe. from the FALLEN SET . note: for the sharpest cat eye, we recommend using your magnet over your nail after every coat (including your top coat).

Name: Noseboop
Description: MAY INSPIRE PUPPY LOVE. NOSEBOOP is a dusty light lavender creme lacquer. From the SUNDOG SET .

Name: Not Today Satan
Description: BLESS YOUR HEART. you must have mistaken this baby pink sweetheart’s kindness for weakness. go ahead: try and test it. try and break it. you’ll only inspire a more concentrated burst of its steadfast poise and grace in all of its holographic beauty. for nothing is so strong as gentleness and as gentle as true strength. NOT TODAY SATAN is a baby pink linear holographic lacquer. from the HEAVY IS THE CROWN collection note: holographic lacquers look best in the sunlight or under a direct light, where they reveal their full rainbow effect. in the shade or overcast conditions, the effect will be more muted (but still mesmerizing).

Name: Nyarrian Nights
Description: MAY INDUCE PURRING. NYARRIAN NIGHTS is a multichrome magnetic lacquer that shifts between pink and red-orange, and reveals a purple base filled with blue shimmer when magnetized. From the PLANET NYARR SET . Need a magnetic wand? Add a free one in cart to create magnetic designs.

Name: Outlaw Country
Description: THE SHARPEST SHADE IN THE WEST. cut your fangs on one of the certified edgiest shades in this here galaxy. like a freshly polished spur or a sharpened point of barbed wire, this gunmetal shade, glittering with a wave of silver shimmer, will bring a welcome taste of metal to even the most down-to-earth claws. OUTLAW COUNTRY is a gunmetal silver metallic lacquer filled with silver shimmer. from the MIDNIGHT RODEO SET .

Name: Pandemonium
Description: UNBOTTLE A LITTLE CHAOS. finally a signature red shade for all you everyday demons. orange bursts of mischief and red pangs of mayhem shimmer and swirl against a rich, red undercurrent of utter anarchy, for a clawfit that’ll complement both your weekday and weekend schemes quite devilishly. PANDEMONIUM is a red lacquer filled with color-shifting red-to-orange shimmer. from the UNDERWORLD SET .

Name: Pandora's Box
Description: UNBOTTLE A LITTLE CHAOS. let curiosity get the best of you and who knows what you’ll unleash when you uncap this thoroughly magnetizing burgundy brew. will you unknowingly summon all the evils of the world to slowly encroach this shimmering purple sphere in a seemingly-gilded velvet swirl? or will you allow a stark golden stripe of hope to remain against a dusky backdrop of impending doom and gloom? you may be the villain in someone else’s story, but it’s wholly up to you how you craft and re-craft this endlessly shapeable slice of your tale… PANDORA’S BOX is a wine burgundy magnetic lacquer filled with purple shimmer that reveals a golden stripe. from the PANDORA UNBOXED SET.

Name: Pangea
Description: SOMETIMES YOU JUST WANT TO DRIFT AWAY… 4EVER. on the days when you feel like you’re barely keeping it together, let this serene dark blue remind you that that’s strictly icon behavior. pop this open and pour one out for your fellow supercontinents past. filled with slow-drifting shifty green-to-orange-to-red ULTRA-fine flakies it may just distract you enough to help you, too, break up with whatever’s holding you back… 4ever. PANGEA is a matte ultra dark blue lacquer filled with color-shifting green-to-orange-to-red ULTRA-fine flakies. from the PRETTY PREHISTORIC SET . finish with a coat of MATTE MADE IN HELL to lock in your look, prolong your wear, + help this shade really pop. not a matte fan? just top this shade w SPEED DEMON TOP COAT for a glossy finish

Name: Paradise Found
Description: THE MIND IS A PLACE. a lush labyrinth that can make a heaven of hell or a hell of heaven. will you bask in the serenity of solitude, and drift away to a jade tone oasis of your own creation? or allow yourself to sample the ripened fruits of your most slithering vices? PARADISE FOUND is a jade mint creme lacquer. from the TECHNICOLOR DREAMS collection.

Name: Pearl Clutcher
Description: AN ODE TO OUR EVERY CRITIC. PEARL CLUTCHER is a pearlescent white shimmer lacquer with subtle shifts through shades of white, light pink, light purple, + green as it’s viewed from different angles. from the DANSE MACABRE SET . Winner of Allure Best of Beauty Awards for Best Longwear Nail Polish. wear + care: appears more chrome-like in shady or overcast conditions glimmers in more direct light no one photo will truly capture its full appearance. we recommend viewing all photos to see the full range of its shifts

Name: Petals for a Narcissist
Description: THIS LACQUER LOVES ITSELF, IT LOVES ITSELF NOT… this lacquer loves looking at itself on your claws. and can you blame it? give it its flowers and bask in the perennial beauty of the romantic punch of violet that pulsates at the heart of this ethereally sheer white-gray bud. it’s so transfixing that it’s been known to distract wearers from any and all impending gloom. 10/10 spring and underworld goddesses alike would pick it. PETALS FOR A NARCISSIST is a sheer white-gray lacquer filled with violet pink shimmer. from the SEASONS OF PERSEPHONE SE T. note: this shade has an intentionally ethereal sheerness, but can be layered to your liking over a coat of our GETTING EVEN NAIL PRIMER for a more opaque look.

Name: Pixiestick
Description: A SWEET, SUGARY RUSH OF PIXIE DUST. set your claws aflutter with this delicate, gossamer wing-like white shade. AMPed up with an intense serving of green shimmer and a soft sprinkle of super micro holo glitter, this tiny but mighty tincture will add a sweet dash of fantasy to even the most mundane of days, as it constantly flickers through a magicalmystical wave of enchanting, iridescent hues. PIXIESTICK is a white lacquer filled with green shimmer and super micro holo glitter. from the LOST IN A FOLKTALE SET .

Name: Planet Nyarr Set
Description: GRAVITY WEIGHING YOU DOWN? VISIT PLANET NYARR. the PLANET NYARR SET includes 9 special effect nail lacquers: KATTERMANJARO , ELECTROMAGNETIC FURBALL , SWIM, MY DOLPHINS , WHISKERED WILLOWS , THE ZOOMIES , NYARRIAN NIGHTS , LITTERBOX , BLUEBERRY’S JAM , and LIGHT OF YOUR NINTH LIFE . Also includes one free magnetic wand.

Name: Plankton
Description: TINY BUT MIGHTY. take up a little aquatic space with this highly invasive shade of gorgeous, gorgeous green. as it drifts over your claws it’ll leave behind a wash of green shimmer and the tiniest super micro holo glitter glints of something more sinister. perhaps a sudden stroke of evil genius? we’ll let your claws decide. PLANKTON is a green lacquer filled with green shimmer and super micro holographic glitter. from the MERMAID TALES SET .

Name: Poems For A Harvest Moon
Description: AN ODE TO THE RISING NIGHT. like a mythical phoenix, this unapologetic shade is the perfect beacon for endlessly blazing your own path. inspired by the seemingly red-orange hues of the harvest moon, this bright orange tincture is set endlessly aglimmer by a fiery pang of pink shimmer. we have a feeling its iridescent spark will help light your way long after each moonset. POEMS FOR A HARVEST MOON is a bright orange crelly lacquer filled with pink shimmer. from the FALLEN SET .

Name: Poison Ivy
Description: HAVE A BRUSH WITH DESTINY. but be warned: once this rich forest creme lacquer has you wrapped in its tendrils, you may find it hard to free yourself from its hypnotic grasp. POISON IVY is a deep forest green creme lacquer.

Name: Poisonberry
Description: TRANCE OF THE SUGARPLUMS. let your nails have a taste. but be forewarned - not everything is so sweet in this woodland retreat. sink your fangs into this juicy lilac berry and you’ll be treated to an intense burst of cold purple shimmer… and a sudden craving for the more nefarious things this modern folktale has to offer. POISONBERRY is a lilac lacquer filled with purple shimmer and micro holo glitter. from the LOST IN A FOLKTALE SET .

Name: Pomegranate Seeds
Description: GET A TASTE OF FORBIDDEN FRUIT. we’ll help you feel like a modern day persephone. simply sink your claws into this juicy reddish purple shade, filled with glittering glints of seed-like orange and pink iridescent flakies and an unexpected burst of cool, blue shimmer. just a taste of this maximalist hue will leave your claws feeling refreshed... and seemingly, inexplicably tied - forever - to all things darkness. POMEGRANATE SEEDS is a reddish purple lacquer filled with blue shimmer and color-shifting orange-to-pink iridescent flakies. from the UNDERWORLD SET .

Name: Port 6666
Description: DESCEND INTO THE UNDERNET, NETCAT. PORT 6666 is a multichrome magnetic lacquer that shifts between magenta pink and purple, and reveals a black-navy base when magnetized. from the WELCOME TO PARADISE SET .

Name: Poseidon's Prize
Description: ADVENTURE IS CALLING TO YOU. set sail across your personal slice of ocean blue. where ye may choose to savor the serene sight of your rippling reflection or summon a thunderous strike of biblical storms - all with the drop of your magnetized trident. POSEIDON’S PRIZE is a deep ocean blue magnetic lacquer filled with reflective glitter that reveals an aqua magnetic stripe. from the EXPEDITION: ATLANTIS set. A NOTE FOR SMOOTH SAILS: reflective magnetic lacquers are highly textured and should be finished with 1-2 layers of our SPEED DEMON TOP COAT. note: all orders with magnetic lacquers include one free magnetic wand.

Name: Prickly Pear
Color(s): Black, Green, Multichrome/Shift, Orange, Pink, Yellow
Description: FRESH CACTUS JUICE. don’t be surprised if this prickly bud becomes inexplicably stuck on you. its mattified cactus green base is blooming with spiky, color-shifting orange, pink, and yellow iridescent flakies - making it a truly jagged little brew perfect for pairing with any mildly jaded point of view. PRICKLY PEAR is a matte cactus green lacquer filled with color-shifting orange, pink, and yellow iridescent flakies. from the MIDNIGHT RODEO SET . finish with a coat of MATTE MADE IN HELL to lock in your look, prolong your wear, + help this shade really pop. not a matte fan? just top this shade w SPEED DEMON TOP COAT for a glossy finish.

Name: Puppy Breath
Description: LIKE A WALK IN THE PARK. PUPPY BREATH is a sage green creme lacquer. From the SUNDOG SET .

Name: Queen of Chaos
Description: YOUR CORONATION AWAITS assume your rightful throne with a regal amethyst creme lacquer fit for an impending reign of mischief. QUEEN OF CHAOS is a deep amethyst purple creme lacquer.

Name: Queen of the Dead
Description: IN THE HEAT OF THE MOMENT. welcome to limbo. cycle through every shade of desire with a fiery thermal lacquer prone to shift with your every fluctuation in fahrenheit. as your temperature rises, and your claws thaw, you’ll see them transition from a deep shade of wine red to a shade of raspberry red. as your feelings chill, you’ll watch as they cycle right back to a deep wine red yet again. occupy the tricky inbetween? and your claws will meld into an ombre-like purgatory. it’s a true study of heat. QUEEN OF THE DEAD is a dark red thermal lacquer that transitions from a shade of deep wine red when cold to a shade of raspberry red when warm. from the SEASONS OF PERSEPHONE SET . note: it can take up to a few hours for the color transitioning effect to be activated for the first time. applying a base coat + finishing this shade with SPEED DEMON TOP COAT is required to prevent chipping + prolong its wear. how a thermal lacquer looks + transitions may vary based on your body chemistry, room conditions, + current climate. due to the nature of thermals, this lacquer will also have a thicker formula.

Name: Quicksand's Embrace
Description: CAN’T SHAKE ITS PULL. sink your claws into the magnetizing warmth of this sandy pink lacquer and you may just get wrapped up in a loathe like summer. with a wave of your magnetic wand, this deceptively demure shade will come alive with a subtle, mirage-like holographic stripe or a velvety subtle silver holo haze. whether you choose to draw a figurative line in the sand or channel the hazy heat of the setting sun, you’ll never be able to escape the grasp of the ever-sinking sands of time. QUICKSAND’S EMBRACE is a dusty pink magnetic lacquer that reveals a soft, subtle silver holographic magnetic stripe. from the SONGS OF SIRENS SET .

Name: Raaawr!
Description: AGGRESSIVELY CUTE. uncovered from the archives of childhood vhs tapes past, comes a cute and cuddly, cartoony lavender shade that’s pure dino-mite. this 100% historically inaccurate specimen is filled with iridescent scale-like flakies that’ll have you feeling like XD. RAAAWR! is a matte lavender lacquer filled with iridescent flakies from the PRETTY PREHISTORIC SET . finish with a coat of MATTE MADE IN HELL to lock in your look, prolong your wear, + help this shade really pop. not a matte fan? just top this shade w SPEED DEMON TOP COAT for a glossy finish.

Name: Rag Doll
Description: THE ONLY LACQUER THAT MAKES ANY SENSE. become a most terrible vision in blue and let your claws get lost in an enthusiastic cloud of cold blue shimmer. it’s a glimmering facade that merely cloaks the most enchanting nightmare: that under the cover of darkness, this most wretched shade glows greener than worm’s wort soup. RAG DOLL is a light blue glow-in-the-dark lacquer filled with blue shimmer. from THE NIGHTMARE BEFORE CHRISTMAS SET , conjured in collaboration with DISNEY TIM BURTON’S THE NIGHTMARE BEFORE CHRISTMAS - and only available for a limited time. for best glow-in-the-dark results: give your bottle a little shake before applying. for the brightest glow, we recommend applying 3 coats. don’t skip your top coat. once you’re done painting, activate the glow by holding your nails under direct light for ~30 seconds. shut off the lights and prepare to fright. to recharge the glow effect, just hold your nails under direct light again. note: due to the highly-pigmented nature of this lacquer, its consistency will gradually grow thicker over time. when needed, simply add a few drops of nail polish thinner, to revitalize the formula. ©Disney

Name: Raven
Description: did you hear that? the faint promise of the impending ‘nevermore.’ a dark omen looms on the horizon in this ominous black matte lacquer. as subtle glints of purple and pink shimmer whisper of what’s always fleeting. RAVEN is a matte black lacquer filled with purple and pink shimmer. while this quick-dry matte lacquer doesn’t require a top coat, you can put a new spin on your narrative by finishing it with our glossy SPEED DEMON TOP COAT .

Name: Requiem for a Swan
Description: SUCCUMB TO CURTAIN’S CALL. REQUIEM FOR A SWAN is a black flakie lacquer filled with translucent flakies and micro holographic glitter. from the DANSE MACABRE SET . wear + care: finish with SPEED DEMON TOP COAT to prevent chipping + extend wear

Name: Return Of The Faves Set
Description: THEY’RE BACK. AND BETTER THAN BEFORE. yes, moonkittens, these are just the ever-so-upgraded LLP faves you’re looking for - all glowed up for the MOONCAT era. get reacquainted with 4 better-than-ever versions of our most-beloved magnetics and 2 of your most-demanded multichrome flakies. and if you’re a new recruit wondering what in the actual universe we’re talking about: don’t worry. tl;dr we know these upgraded takes on forever faves will quickly win over your heart, too. note: all orders with magnetic lacquers include one free magnetic wand . the RETURN OF THE FAVES SET includes six lacquers: VELVET ROSE , APPARITION , DRAGON SCALES , SMOKESCREEN , MALEVOLENT , SUPERVILLIAN WARNING: this product can expose you to chemicals including chromium and nickel, which are known to the state of CALIFORNIA to cause cancer and reproductive harm. for more information visit www.p65warnings.ca.gov

Name: Ribbit Ribbit
Description: 呱呱 | A CONCERTO IN CROAK MAJOR. let your claws leapfrog about in a vibrant pastel green coat pitter-pattering with little light blue droplets of shimmer, that glimmer like the most percussive pops of rain drops. RIBBIT RIBBIT is a vibrant pastel green lacquer filled with light blue shimmer. from the REMEDY SET . note: we recommend applying 3 coats of this shade for full opacity + impact.

Name: River Styx
Description: SINK FULLY INTO THE DEPTHS. take your claws on a journey through the unseen realm, as you float through a serene wave of teal blue pigment glowing with a truly spirited burst of ghostly green shimmer. it’ll leave your mortal paws looking like a million obols. RIVER STYX is a teal blue lacquer filled with green shimmer. from the UNDERWORLD SET .

Name: Root of All Evil
Description: BLOOM LIKE A WEED. dig into this delectable deep burgundy red brew and you may just lay the roots of something truly villainous. with each swipe, your claws will begin to become more and more overcome by an ever-shifting purple-to-teal-to-green-yellow wave of something wonderfully wicked, until you’re fully overtaken by the tendrils of a most monstrous bloom. ROOT OF ALL EVIL is a semi-sheer deep burgundy red lacquer jam-packed with color-shifting teal-to-green-yellow shimmer. from the PANDORA UNBOXED SET .

Name: Rue Morgue
Description: Dress to kill. velvety rich with a chilling blue shimmer — you’ll knock ‘em dead. RUE MORGUE is a matte blue lacquer filled with red, violet, and blue shimmer. while this quick-dry matte lacquer doesn’t require a top coat, you can put a new spin on your narrative by finishing it with our glossy SPEED DEMON TOP COAT .

Name: Sabertooth
Description: LOOK WHAT THE CAT DRAGGED IN. freshly unearthed from the tar pits, it’s the long-fossilized remnants of our fiercest brethren. like ice-cold fangs, this mattified baby blue specimen seemingly-glows with an intense blue shimmer - making it a fittingly fierce hue for your own ferocious, feline-like claws. SABERTOOTH is a matte baby blue lacquer filled with bright blue shimmer. from the PRETTY PREHISTORIC SET . note: this lacquer will naturally level out as it dries down. we recommend 2-3 coats for the most even finish. finish with a coat of MATTE MADE IN HELL to lock in your look, prolong your wear, + help this shade really pop. not a matte fan? just top this shade w SPEED DEMON TOP COAT for a glossy finish.

Name: Sagebrush
Description: MANIFEST SOMETHING TRULY TRANSFORMATIVE. pick this herbaceous shade and you’ll treat your claws to an endlessly soothing respite. allow yourself a mindful moment, and watch as it shifts from serene shades of holo-dusted light sage, while your temperature rises, to a deep ivy green, while your temperature cools. it may just stir spontaneous pangs of soft introspection along the way. SAGEBRUSH is a sage green thermal lacquer with holographic glitter that transitions from a shade of ivy green when cold to a shade of light sage when warm. from the FALLEN SET . note: it can take up to a few hours for the color transitioning effect to be activated for the first time. applying a base coat + finishing this shade with SPEED DEMON TOP COAT is required to prevent chipping + prolong its wear. how a thermal lacquer looks + transitions may vary based on your body chemistry, room conditions, + current climate. due to the nature of thermals, this lacquer will also have a thicker formula. slight separation is normal for thermal polish.

Name: Sakura's Serenade
Description: 櫻花小夜曲 | A PERENNIAL SLICE OF EPHEMERAL BEAUTY. allow your claws to momentarily come into bloom with this pink temperature-reactive hue, inspired by the brief but beautiful splendor of cherry blossom season. softly swaying through blue-shimmer-dusted shades of hot pink, as you run cold, and light pink, as you bask in warmer rays, this wholesome hex will leave you ever-charmed. SAKURA’S SERENADE is a pink thermal lacquer filled with blue shimmer that transitions from a shade of hot pink when cold to a shade of light pink when warm. from the REMEDY SET . we recommend applying 3 coats of this shade for full opacity + impact. note: due to the nature of the special pigments used, this lacquer will have a thicker formula. it may also cause some separation to occur in bottle. this is normal + won’t affect the application or finish. simply shake well before each use. how a thermal lacquer looks + transitions may vary based on your body chemistry, room conditions, + current climate. it can take up to a few hours for the color transitioning effect to be activated for the first time. applying a base coat + finishing this shade with SPEED DEMON TOP COAT is required to prevent chipping + prolong its wear.

Name: Sand Viper
Description: DON’T LET EM FOOL YOU. wriggling around in the sandy terrain it calls home, this neutral-tone, light pink-beige phenom is packing an unexpectedly fiery bite. its semi-sheer visage slithers with teeny-tiny scale-like glints of orange-red shimmer - that have been known to strike with a hypnotizing glow at the faintest hint of sunlight. SAND VIPER is a sheer, light pink-beige jelly lacquer filled with orange-red shimmer. from the MIDNIGHT RODEO SET . note: this shade has an intentionally ethereal sheerness, but can be layered to your liking over GETTING EVEN NAIL PRIMER for maximum opacity.

Name: Sealed With A Hiss
Description: CONSIDER THIS A WARNING. this lacquer is a force to be reckoned with. but so are you. so sink your fangs into this suitably fierce shade. as it cycles through vibrant waves of your violet-with-envy and blue mood, and glitters with pangs of your innermost holographic fury, warn any would-be-opponents, that you, too, pack a purely wicked bite. SEALED WITH A HISS is a duochrome lacquer filled with holographic glitter that shifts between shades of violet and blue. from the MEDUSA UNLEASHED SET .

Name: Seasons of Persephone Set
Description: A MARRIAGE OF HEAVEN + HEATHEN… this isn’t a tragedy. it’s an ode to love – and every shade of its messy, multifaceted glory. a sprawling, epic, hero’s journey from lush, overgrown fields, through the darkest depths…and back again. cycle through shades as fiendishly frigid + ethereally warm as your ever fluttering temperament, as you sink your claws into a hauntingly beautiful arrangement of 9 devilishly divine NEW lacquers - shimmering perennial blooms, glimmering infernal fancies, an earthy magnetic, + something truly necromantic - mooncat’s very first thermal. for QUEEN OF THE DEAD , applying a base coat + finishing this shade with SPEED DEMON TOP COAT is required to prevent chipping + prolong its wear. the SEASONS OF PERSEPHONE SET includes 9 special effect nail lacquers: QUEEN OF THE DEAD , PETALS FOR A NARCISSIST , FRESHLY BITTEN , GARDEN OF EVIL , TO ALL WHO GHOSTED ME , LOVEBOMB , THE TROUBLE WITH IMMORTALITY , DEVIL’S IVY , and FIELDS OF ELYSIUM .

Name: Serpents of Eden
Description: LOOKS CAN BE DECEIVING. never was there a more cunning beast. blink and this endlessly-shifty green multichrome will already have emerged completely anew. you can try to resist its never-ending trance, as it cycles through a mesmerizing wave of shades like green, teal, yellow, and blue, but you’ll find it hard to pull yourself away from the sleight of hand you’ve played on, well, you. SERPENTS OF EDEN is a multichrome lacquer that shifts between shades of green, teal, yellow, and blue as it’s viewed from different angles. from the PANDORA UNBOXED SET .

Name: Serpent’s Tongue
Description: FOR THOSE WHO SPEAK IN DAGGERS. allow us to help you sharpen your nail vocabulary. level up your lexicon with this biting purple brew, filled with a fierce lick of green shimmer, and hypnotizing slithers of holographic glitter. your mortal enemies will never fully recover from the impact of your impending clawing. SERPENT’S TONGUE is a duochrome lacquer filled with holographic glitter that shifts between shades of purple and green. from the MEDUSA UNLEASHED SET .

Name: Shapeshifter
Description: morph seamlessly between forms. wielders of this dark crystal have been known to perfect the craft of stealthful nail transformation. with its superfine glass grit, this crystal nail file will allow you to practice your dark arts safely, helping you make effortless shifts between almond, square, oval, diamond, or any nail shape in between. and, then, back again. all while remaining practically imperceptible. a SHAPESHIFTER is a crystal nail file with a superfine glass grit that allows for safer, smoother filing. note: shapeshifters are fragile at their core. when not in use, store your crystal nail file in the cozy protective coffin provided to help prolong its lifespan.

Name: Shattered Glass
Description: SOME THINGS WERE MEANT TO BE BROKEN. forged from the glittering remnants of decimated barriers and severed ceilings. gaze deep into its sparkling lilac reflection and you may just see flares of your own sharp, hard-earned edges in all of their holographic glory. SHATTERED GLASS is a lilac linear holographic lacquer. from the HEAVY IS THE CROWN collection. note: holographic lacquers look best in the sunlight or under a direct light, where they reveal their full rainbow effect. in the shade or overcast conditions, the effect will be more muted (but still mesmerizing).

Name: Sheep's Clothing
Description: CLOAK YOUR CLAWS IN A RAREMADE REWARDS-EXCLUSIVE SHADE. it may seem merely like a sweet, light gray lacquer glimmering with pink shimmer in the shade, but, in the light, this linear holo unleashes the unexpected extent of its holographic rainbow fury. don’t miss the chance to add this rewards-exclusive shade to your wolfpack. it’s only available for reward redemption in THE MISFITS CLUB - and only while supplies last. SHEEP’S CLOTHING is a limited-edition light gray linear holographic RAREMADE lacquer filled with pink shimmer. only available for reward redemption in THE MISFITS CLUB while supplies last. what’s a RAREMADE lacquer? sometimes, a pigment batch we order arrives looking slightly different (in color, size, etc.) than what we approved, + can’t be used for an intended shade. RAREMADES reimagine these perfectly usable, but unintentionally unique, limited pigment batches into something truly one-of-a-kind.

Name: Shroomdom
Description: WHEREFORE ART THOU, GNOMEO? wanna take your claws on their own totally f a r o u t little journey? uncap this enchanted red jelly tincture and set your nails aglitter and aglow with bitty bits of holo glitter and magical multicolor flakies that twinkle like a teeny tiny kingdom of technicolor toadstools. SHROOMDOM is a red jelly lacquer filled with iridescent flakies and holo glitter. from the LOST IN A FOLKTALE SET .

Name: Sin Eater
Description: ABSOLVE ALL YOUR CLAW MISDEEDS. leave your bad luck behind. let this moody, broody deep wine purple lacquer swallow all your claw misdoings whole. with a captivating wave of color-shifting pigment and a slow simmering blaze of shimmering red, orange, and green shades, it’ll help erode evildoings past…while allowing for a fresh slew of sinister plots to brew. SIN EATER is a deep wine purple lacquer filled with subtle color-shifting red-to-orange-to-green shimmer. from the BAND OF MISFITS SET . note: we recommend applying 3 coats to achieve the deep color show in the cover photo, 2 coats for a lighter color

Name: Sinking Feeling
Description: LET THE WEIGHT OF THE WORLD WASH AWAY. give into the sudden jolt. the familiar freefall. and surrender to the unavoidable allure of this sky blue expanse, as you sink slowly into the plush, quilted tides below. SINKING FEELING is a sky blue creme lacquer. from the TECHNICOLOR DREAMS collection.

Name: Siren's Deceit
Description: tempting promises follow the siren’s call and your wish just might be granted. or not. SIREN'S DECEIT is a violet lacquer filled with blue shimmer and holographic micro glitter.

Name: Smokescreen
Description: ALLOW US TO DISTRACT YOU. want a masterclass in misdirection? let the inexplicable magnetism of this mysterious gray haze pull you in. it’s a welcome diversion if we’ve ever seen one. dazzling with unexpected bursts of holographic silver glitter in one moment… and in another, suddenly shifting your gaze with a hypnotizing dance through pink-to-orange hues. SMOKESCREEN is a gray magnetic lacquer filled with silver micro holographic glitter that reveals a pink-to-orange multichrome magnetic stripe. this is STELLAR HALO 2.0. note: all orders with magnetic lacquers include one free magnetic wand . WARNING: this product can expose you to chemicals including chromium, which is known to the state of CALIFORNIA to cause cancer and reproductive harm. for more information visit www.p65warnings.ca.gov

Name: Snake Charmer
Description: UNLEASH A TRULY HYPNOTIZING HEX. leave no stone uncharmed. dabble in this entrancing teal-to-turquoise brew at your own risk. with its hypnotizing helping of holographic sparkles, this transfixing hex has been known to leave a slew of starry eyed mortals slithering lovelorn in wearers’ wake. SNAKE CHARMER is a duochrome lacquer filled with holographic glitter that shifts between shades of deep teal and turquoise. from the MEDUSA UNLEASHED SET .

Name: Songs of Sirens Set
Description: HEED THESE WHISPERS FROM THE DEEP… for our tale is surfacing, at long last, from the fathoms beneath… we’ve bottled every wrong incurred, brewed fresh vengeance, + fermented our laments to all your “villain” origin stories, transposing each into a most beguiling key to form 9 thoroughly hypnotic harmonies – shimmering + flakie-filled pseudo-shanties, shapeshifting thermal ditties, + a few literally magnetic incantations – including a first-in-the-mooniverse soft holographic magnetic. you can block your ears + hide your heart but you’ll inevitably fall prey to the irresistible allure of each unshakable melody… the SONGS OF SIRENS SET includes 9 special effect nail lacquers: TREACHERY IN THE BLUE , DARK OMENS , QUICKSAND’S EMBRACE , AM I EVERYTHING YOU FEAR? , MAELSTROM , THE SIRENS’ REVENGE , THE SEA BETWEEN US , GHOST SHIP , and A MOST DESTRUCTIVE MELODY . note: due to its unique formula, you may notice that DARK OMENS has a slightly stronger scent than our other shades, particularly if you are sensitive to scents. all orders with magnetic lacquers include one free magnetic wand .

Name: Spaceoddity
Description: VOTED MOST ECCENTRIC. prepare to make contact with the galaxy’s most-requested berry multichrome flakie. with a seemingly ever-changing wave of color-shifting berry pink, purple, orange, and green shades, this multichrome flakie will send your claws into orbit, as it cycles through a claweidoscope of otherworldly possibilities. SPACEODDITY ​​is a multichrome flakie lacquer that shifts between shades of berry pink, purple, orange, and green. from the BAND OF MISFITS SET .

Name: Spawn of Medusa
Description: THANKS FOR THE VENOM. make mother medusa proud. unbottle your festering fury and dip your claws into something suitably serpentine. as this sinister shade slithers from green-to-gray and crackles with golden glints of your most holographic inner fire, it’ll have all of your nail nemeses recoiling with near immediate regret. SPAWN OF MEDUSA is a duochrome lacquer filled with holographic glitter that shifts between shades of green and gray. from the MEDUSA UNLEASHED SET .

Name: Speed Demon Top Coat
Description: we’re sensing that you, too, are a bit of an impatient fiend. no need to let your mortal vices destroy the fruits of your delicate toil. one coat of SPEED DEMON TOP COAT will help you seal in your lacquer and seal out near-immediate regret. lucky for you, this super glossy quick-drying top coat dries wickedly fast, so you can quickly get back to causing earthly mayhem. SPEED DEMON TOP COAT is a super glossy quick-drying top coat.

Name: Spirit Water
Description: PERFECT FOR EVERY TEARBENDER. SPIRIT WATER is a gray to aqua thermal lacquer filled with color-shifting, iridescent aqua-to-green flakies, that transitions from a shade of slate gray when cold to light aqua when warm. from our AVATAR: THE LAST AIRBENDER collaboration collection - and only available for a limited time. wear + care: features a limited-edition waterbending bottle design with a special gold cap + a limited-edition WATER TRIBE carton thermal effects may vary based on body chemistry, temperature, + climate formula tends to be thicker due to the special pigments used. when needed, simply add a few drops of LACQUER REVITALIZER , to revive its consistency. use a base coat + SPEED DEMON TOP COAT to prevent chipping + extend wear note: this item only ships to the US and CANADA. © 2025 Viacom International Inc.

Name: Stolen Ambrosia
Description: A FEAST FROM THE HEAVENS. dabble in the sinful and anoint your mortal claws with this luxe coral meld of gilded orange and shimmering yellow specks - surreptitiously plucked from the dishes of olympus’s finest and bottled in this truly indulgent concoction. tantalus would most definitely approve. STOLEN AMBROSIA is a coral lacquer filled with orange and yellow shimmer. from the UNDERWORLD SET .

Name: Strangeberry
Description: FRESHLY PICKED FROM THE MOON. sometimes reality bites. so sink your fangs into this sweet and tangy escape. filled with the iridescent seeds of mind-altering knowledge, this prickly pink fruit will help you cultivate 100% long-lasting and totally homegrown v i b e s. STRANGEBERRY is a hot pink jelly lacquer filled with green and pink iridescent flakies. its buildable formula can be layered to your liking, for either a semi-sheer or more opaque look. from the KALEIDOSCOPE HAZE SET .

Name: Stumped
Description: FRESH FROM THE WOODWORK. when you inevitably can’t decide what shade to wear, know that you can truly never go wrong with this v enchanted neutral. it’s a real chip off the old block - a rich, bark-like dark brown filled with a cascading rush of leaf-like flakies that color-shift between summery greens and warm autumnal hues even faster than the seemingly ever-changing seasons. STUMPED is brown jelly lacquer filled with iridescent flakies. from the LOST IN A FOLKTALE SET .

Name: Such Sweet Sorrow
Description: CHAPTER VII: WHEN REALITY COMES CRASHING IN. what a deep blue wave. spawned by unfathomable shallowness, now as boundless as the sea. ripples of purple-pink shimmer send shivers of what once was…suspended in an inescapable wave of endless blue. a picture of heartache. SUCH SWEET SORROW is a blue purple lacquer filled with color-shifting purple-to-pink shimmer. from the BAROQUEN SET .

Name: Sugar and Spice Topper
Description: FILLED WITH EVERYTHING NICE. SUGAR AND SPICE TOPPER is a matte topper filled with multicolored iridescent flakies and micro holographic glitter in a clear base. from the BAND OF MISFITS II SET – and available for a limited time. wear + care finish with a coat of MATTE MADE IN HELL to lock in your look + prolong your wear. not a matte fan? just top this shade with SPEED DEMON TOP COAT for a glossy finish.

Name: Sundog Set
Description: LOOK WHAT MADE IT OUT OF THE DOGHOUSE. The SUNDOG SET includes 6 creme nail lacquers: BLOODHOUND , ALL BARK , UNDERDOG , PUPPY BREATH , WISHBONE , and NOSEBOOP .

Name: Supernatural
Color(s): Blue, Green, Multichrome/Shift, Orange, Pink, Purple, Red, Yellow
Description: unexplained phenomena have been reported ahead. spectacular tales and supposed sightings of iridescent flakies floating against a romantic magenta jelly backdrop with otherworldly allure. catch these shifting spectres and you just might witness the dazzling transformations of lore, mesmerizing shifts in form, from shades of yellow to green to blue and violet to red to orange. SUPERNATURAL is a magenta jelly lacquer filled with color-shifting iridescent flakies. this lacquer gets darker with each coat. we recommend using 2-3 coats to get the look in our photos.

Name: Supervillain
Description: UNBOTTLE YOUR WRATH. suit up for world domination with a claw-coat worthy of your larger-than-life aspirations. its unexpected, near-constant BAM WHAM KAPOW through shades of purple and blue, is a superhuman feat guaranteed to leave your nemeses shook. SUPERVILLAIN is a multichrome flakie lacquer filled with holographic glitter that shifts between shades of blue and purple. this is BEBOP 2.0. WARNING: this product can expose you to chemicals including chromium, which is known to the state of CALIFORNIA to cause cancer and reproductive harm. for more information visit www.p65warnings.ca.gov

Name: Sweet Nightmare
Description: FAMILIAR FRIGHTS. rockabye and hold the devil you know tight. peer deep into the mysteries of the peri shadows as they emerge at the first signs of moonlight. it’s a thing of haunting beauty that you’ll never truly want to part with. SWEET NIGHTMARE is a periwinkle creme lacquer. from the TECHNICOLOR DREAMS collection.

Name: Swim, My Dolphins
Description: LIKE SWIMMING THROUGH AN IRIDESCENT SKY. SWIM, MY DOLPHINS is a cyan shimmer lacquer. From the PLANET NYARR SET . Wear + Care: For maximum opacity, we recommend applying 3 coats

Name: Taipan Venom
Description: CAMOFLAUGE YOUR VENOM. TAIPAN VENOM is a gold magnetic lacquer filled with light green shimmer and bronze flakies that reveals a brown base when magnetized. from the DEADLY BY NATURE SET .

Name: Take Me to Your Leader
Description: GREETINGS, EARTHLINGS. beamed straight from the mothership, a transcendent being has appeared. a galactic royal of sorts. emanating an alluring violet glow and offering familiar hints of earthly diplomacy. calculated displays of patience and poise that ever so slowly waver and wane with the passing of time. an unintended glitch that begins to rapidly erode its carefully-manufactured guise, revealing glimmers of its nefarious amber-tinted intentions. and an unshakably sinister air. TAKE ME TO YOUR LEADER is a multichrome lacquer that shifts between shades of lavender and amber as it’s viewed from different angles.

Name: Tales of Ba Sing Se
Description: THERE IS NO LACQUER IN BA SING SE. TALES OF BA SING SE is a multichrome magnetic lacquer that shifts between yellow and orange, and reveals a green base when magnetized. from our AVATAR: THE LAST AIRBENDER collaboration collection - and only available for a limited time. wear + care: features a limited-edition earthbending bottle design with a special gold cap + a limited-edition EARTH KINGDOM carton note: this item only ships to the US and CANADA. © 2025 Viacom International Inc.

Name: Technicolor Dreams Set
Description: GET LOST IN A FEVER DREAM. a world of your own creation. where your darkest fantasies and most vivid frights come alive in full technicolor. awaken the furthest reaches of your imagination with a dreamy palette of ten new cremes. and float freely through a surreal expanse all your own. the TECHNICOLOR DREAMS collection set includes ten creme lacquers: EUPHORIC , an orchid pink lacquer, INSOMNIAC , a lilac lacquer, SWEET NIGHTMARE , a periwinkle lacquer, SINKING FEELING , a sky blue lacquer, PARADISE FOUND , a jade mint lacquer, NEVERLAND , a baby lime lacquer, ETERNAL SUNSHINE , a light yellow lacquer, ACIDIC , a tangerine lacquer, LUCID DREAM , a peachy coral lacquer, and WHITE RABBIT , a white lacquer.

Name: Tectonic Shift
Color(s): Green, Multichrome/Shift, Orange, Pink, Teal, Yellow
Description: THE MAGNITUDE OF THIS MATTIFIED SHADE… don’t underestimate its demure power. this one will have a seismic effect over your claws, as its matte seafoam surface perma-quakes between glimmering shades of yellow, orange, and pink. it’s truly off the richter. TECTONIC SHIFT is a matte seafoam green lacquer jam-packed with color-shifting yellow-to-orange-to-pink ULTRA-fine flakies. from the PRETTY PREHISTORIC SET . finish with a coat of MATTE MADE IN HELL to lock in your look, prolong your wear, + help this shade really pop. not a matte fan? just top this shade w SPEED DEMON TOP COAT for a glossy finish.

Name: The 13th Hour
Description: LIKE A BRIGHT, COLD SUMMER’S DAY. for that fresh when-hell-freezes-over glow just dip your claws into this delightfully ominous shade. as blue shimmer twinkles against its blackest black base, it’s sure to stir all-too unfamiliar feelings of impossibly fond days never passed. THE 13TH HOUR is a black lacquer filled with blue shimmer.

Name: The Arsonist
Description: FROM THE EMBERS OF PERPETUAL DESTRUCTION... comes an appropriately unapologetic shade fit for all the indiscriminate, metaphorical bridge-burners. take a break from all of your figurative fire-breathing and flamethrowing and simply slip your claws into this equally rebellious deep red shimmer. and with your fiery red heart on your claws, who knows, you may just feel more inclined to, say, productively blaze your own path versus, you know, leaving a trail of wrathful desolation in your wake. THE ARSONIST is a deep red lacquer filled with red shimmer. from the PANDORA UNBOXED SET .

Name: The Avatar State
Description: THE BRIGHTEST IN THE DARK. THE AVATAR STATE is a sheer white glow-in-the-dark lacquer filled with blue shimmer that glows bright aqua in the dark. from our AVATAR: THE LAST AIRBENDER collaboration collection - and only available for a limited time. wear + care: features a limited-edition airbending bottle design with a special gold cap + a limited-edition AIR NOMADS carton this shade has an intentionally ethereal sheerness that helps give it a delicate appearance can be layered to your liking over GETTING EVEN NAIL PRIMER for a more opaque look for the brightest glow, we recommend applying 3 coats glow color may look different depending on what light source you charge it under due to the highly-pigmented nature of this lacquer, its consistency will gradually grow thicker over time when needed, simply add a few drops of LACQUER REVITALIZER , to revive its consistency how to use: give your bottle a shake before applying to activate glow effect, hold your nails under direct light for ~30 seconds before shutting off the lights note: this item only ships to the US and CANADA. © 2025 Viacom International Inc.

Name: The Dark Side
Description: will you be seduced by its influence? illuminate your inner darkness with this black metallic lacquer. glints of silvery luminescence create a powerful contrast against its blackest-black base. THE DARK SIDE is a black metallic lacquer filled with dark silver foil flakies and blue holographic glitter.

Name: The Doppelganger
Description: UNCAP YOUR SHADOW SELF. THE DOPPELGANGER is a dark purple to mauve thermal lacquer filled with pink-purple shimmer that transitions from a shade of dark purple when cold to mauve when warm. from the DANSE MACABRE SET . wear + care: thermal effects may vary based on body chemistry, temperature, + climate formula tends to be thicker due to the special pigments used use a base coat + SPEED DEMON TOP COAT to prevent chipping + extend wear

Name: The Firebird
Description: A TRANSFORMATIVE ORIGIN STORY – TOLD IN TWO PARTS. THE FIREBIRD is a black to deep plum thermal lacquer filled with orange shimmer, that transitions from black when cold to deep plum when warm. from the BAND OF MISFITS II SET – and available for a limited time.

Name: The Glory of Innocence
Description: IS THIS A GLIMMER OF HOPE? could this be a blessing in disguise? or is it merely the most spectacular shade of sorrow? filled with ever-fleeting jolts of electrifying rainbowy holo and the otherworldly glimmer of glowy green shimmer, there’s something undoubtedly both ethereal and nostalgic about this cheery slice of life. but set against a dusky purple backdrop, you can’t help but feel like this harrowing holographic shimmer is really filled with a sense of ever-encroaching gloom, and the memory of all those rainbow and sunshiney days long past and forever fleeting. THE GLORY OF INNOCENCE is a purple and green holographic shimmer lacquer. from the PANDORA UNBOXED SET .

Name: The Living Doll
Description: A DELICATE DANCE. THE LIVING DOLL is a sheer blush pink lacquer filled with strong blue-violet shimmer. from the DANSE MACABRE SET . wear + care: this shade has an intentionally ethereal sheerness that helps give it a delicate appearance can be layered to your liking over GETTING EVEN NAIL PRIMER for a more opaque look specially formulated to neutralize the appearance of yellowing + staining caused by lacquer pigment deposits, making it a sheer lacquer everyone can confidently wear

Name: The Sea Between Us
Description: AN OCEAN APART. whenever you’re feeling at odds, wade into the inbetween, an unexpectedly serene slice of blue perma-shimmering and glimmering with pops of sunglitter-like holo. you never know when you may be overcome with briney bits of iridescent, seafoam-y green flakies thrashing through ever-fluctuating hues like raging waves. at some angles appearing so similar and at others at such odds. what a great expanse to dive into… THE SEA BETWEEN US is an ocean blue jelly lacquer jam-packed with green iridescent flakies, light blue shimmer, and micro holographic glitter. from the SONGS OF SIRENS SET .

Name: The Silent Scream
Description: FACE YOUR GHOSTS. THE SILENT SCREAM is a silver magnetic lacquer that reveals a deep black base when magnetized. from the DANSE MACABRE SET .

Name: The Sirens' Revenge
Description: AS SWEET AS SALTWATER. send your claws into a tailspin. surging through its seemingly serene seafoam surface, like an invasive bloom of kelp or a cascade of encroaching seaweed, this minty brew is quickly overcome with a deceptively potent punch of blue-green shimmer. as it shifts back and forth from iridescent glimmers of blue to green, it may feel like you're tracking the ethereal shift of scaly wings on a flock of flightless birds or perhaps, more accurately, being tracked by a thousand beady eyes strategically plotting their next move… THE SIRENS’ REVENGE is a mint green lacquer filled with color-shifting blue-to-green shimmer. from the SONGS OF SIRENS SET .

Name: The Stolen Kiss
Description: CHAPTER II: HIDDEN IN THE ROSE GARDEN... there you are beneath the dappled shade of the bosque trees. turning lilac like a bed of the most fragrant roses. a rosy hue like the blush of freshly flushed cheeks. the natural glow of just brushed hands, chins, knees. with the yellow glimmering rays of golden hour just upon you, feeling overcome by sudden shimmering pangs of blue and green, and delightfully faint of heart. THE STOLEN KISS is a lilac pink lacquer filled with chromey color-shifting yellow-to-blue-to-green shimmer. from the BAROQUEN SET .

Name: The Stranger
Description: THE SKY WAS GREEN. I FELT GOOD. but i went straight home because i wanted to re-lacquer my claws. i had worked all day. potatoes were on the stove. and i ran into this lacquer on my way up the stairs. it says to me, “if you open yourself up to the gentle indifference of this olive hue, you may just find it so much like yourself.” i did. i felt that I had been happy and that i was happy again. THE STRANGER is an olive green creme lacquer. from the A TALE OF 5 LACQUERS SET .

Name: The Trouble with Immortality
Description: ALL THAT GLISTENS IS NOT GOLD. for sometimes it’s bronze. and like a bronze anvil descending from the heavens, the weight this bronzed beacon carries, the responsibility, may just have an unexpectedly everlasting impact over your paws. let it anoint your claws, with its beautiful bronzed luster, and the ever-present twinkle of tiny bits of bronze metallic luster will slowly collect with each and every glacial coat, like the ever-growing sands of time. never ever fleeting. never waning. glimmering, shimmering, and shining, inescapable…forevermore. THE TROUBLE WITH IMMORTALITY is a bronze metallic lacquer. from the SEASONS OF PERSEPHONE SET .

Name: The Vanisher
Description: AND FOR MY NEXT TRICK… i’ll make all of your overzealous lacquer strokes disappear! simply grab THE VANISHER, dip it in your preferred nail lacquer removal potion, wave its durable bristles ceremoniously over any errant smudges, and VOILA! it’s as if they were never there at all. THE VANISHER is a durable clean-up brush known to make lacquer smudges quickly disappear.

Name: The Zoomies
Description: GO FERAL. THE ZOOMIES is a sheer light green glow-in-the-dark lacquer that glows green in the dark. From the PLANET NYARR SET . Wear + Care: This shade has an intentionally ethereal sheerness that helps give it a delicate appearance For the brightest glow, we recommend applying 3 coats Due to the highly-pigmented nature of this lacquer, its consistency will gradually grow thicker over time Simply add a few drops of LACQUER REVITALIZER , to revive its consistency How to Use: Glow pigments will settle in bottle when not in use. Give your bottle a shake before applying To activate glow effect, hold your nails under direct light for at least 30 seconds before shutting off the lights Your light source can affect glow strength + glow color. Charge with sunlight for the strongest glow

Name: This Is A Storm Warning
Description: THEY CALL ME THE BRINGER OF DOOM + GLOOM. and would you look at the forecast it’s beginning to look a bit overcast your judgment’s about to get clouded and your magnetized claws are about to get shrouded in turbulent wisps of purple gray as a downpour of shimmering blue-violet raindrops and a bevy of glittering holo dewdrops head your way. THIS IS A STORM WARNING is a light purple gray magnetic lacquer filled with soft violet blue shimmer and micro holographic glitter, that reveals a silver magnetic stripe. from the MY INNER APOCALYPSE: AN EP FOR EXISTENTIAL DAYS SET .

Name: Through The Wormhole
Description: push ahead into the void. a universe of opportunity awaits you on the other side. it’s no stretch, this dark green linear holographic lacquer will rocket your style into the far-flung future. THROUGH THE WORMHOLE is a dark green linear holographic lacquer. note: holographic lacquers look best in the sunlight or under a direct light, where they reveal their full rainbow effect. in the shade or overcast conditions, the effect will be more muted (but still mesmerizing).

Name: To All Who Ghosted Me
Description: YOU’LL NEVER DEFROST MY HEART. for you have sucked me of all my warmth. left me out in the cold to become a dust-covered lilac shell. decimated my being bit by bit by bit with a thousand small, slow cuts of indifference. each internalized, fermented, and hardened into an ever-encroaching blue frost – the numbing blue shimmer of the icy, ghostly trail i’ll leave – similarly – behind any and all who dare chase me. TO ALL WHO GHOSTED ME ​​is a dusty lilac lacquer filled with blue shimmer. from the SEASONS OF PERSEPHONE SET .

Name: Treachery in the Blue
Description: WADE INTO UNCHARTED WATERS… …where your claws control the ever-shifting tides. what treachery lurks beneath? as your temperature rises, the holo dusted waves will wane, revealing the sparkling sands of a mysterious, sheer beige-pink terrain. and as your temperature cools, a calming rush of blue will begin to wash over your claws yet again. let the unpredictable ebb and flow of the great blue continue to wax and wane alongside you all the day through. TREACHERY IN THE BLUE is a blue thermal lacquer with micro holo glitter that transitions from a shade of blue when cold to a sheer neutral shade when warm. from the SONGS OF SIRENS SET . note: it can take up to a few hours for the color transitioning effect to be activated for the first time. applying GETTING EVEN NAIL PRIMER as a base + topping this shade with SPEED DEMON TOP COA T is required to prevent chipping + prolong its wear. how a thermal lacquer looks + transitions may vary based on your body chemistry, room conditions, + current climate.

Name: Trending Purples Set
Description: IT’S A ROYAL AFFAIR. we’ve commissioned a regal procession of our favorite purples for your enjoyment. with holographic, matte, creme, shimmer, and multichrome shades to enjoy, we know this dazzling set will make a prized addition to any lacquer trove. the TRENDING PURPLES SET includes five lacquers: MIDNIGHT DRIVE , a vibrant violet creme, ANTIFRAGILE , a linear holographic indigo, MORTALS BE WARNED , a multichrome that shifts between shades of indigo and berry, DREAM WITHIN A DREAM , a matte deep purple with red, violet, and blue shimmer, and SHATTERED GLASS , a linear holographic lilac.

Name: Triceratops
Description: AND, UP AHEAD, YOU’LL SEE… a mattified, fossilized sample of a most formidable contender. stuffed with leafy, ultra-glowy green-to-blue flakies to satiate all its herbivorous cravings. it’s a protective charcoal gray presence known to watch peacefully over all clawed creatures - and only reveal the true strength of its menacing, unrivaled horns when it really really needs to. TRICERATOPS is a matte charcoal gray lacquer filled with color-shifting blue-to-green iridescent flakies. from the PRETTY PREHISTORIC SET . finish with a coat of MATTE MADE IN HELL to lock in your look, prolong your wear, + help this shade really pop. not a matte fan? just top this shade w SPEED DEMON TOP COAT for a glossy finish.

Name: Twilight Sonata
Description: WE TRANSPOSED YOUR EVERY FEELING… and bottled them in a truly evocative key, a soothing song simply begging to be played. guide your claws on a journey from dusk to dawn through endless stanzas of an ever-shifting melody. when the moon begins to set, and the heat from within begins to rise, your claws will greet you with the first peeks of bright purple dayrise. and once the heat begins to retreat, and a chill washes over your claws, you’ll be overcome, yet again, by the beauty of a blue-twinkling midnight.
