TWILIGHT SONATA is a midnight blue-purple thermal lacquer filled with blue shimmer that transitions from a shade of midnight when cold to a shade of bright amethyst purple when warm. from the FALLEN SET . note: it can take up to a few hours for the color transitioning effect to be activated for the first time. slight separation is normal for thermal polish. applying a base coat + finishing this shade with SPEED DEMON TOP COAT is required to prevent chipping + prolong its wear. how a thermal lacquer looks + transitions may vary based on your body chemistry, room conditions, + current climate. due to the nature of thermals, this lacquer will also have a thicker formula.

Name: Tyrannosaurus Hex
Description: CONJURE A LITTLE JURASSIC SPARK. sink your tiny claws into this metaphorically MASSIVE matte shade and you’ll paint your clawversaries green w envy. bc this ferocious phenom packs a truly powerful bite - w a seemingly never-ending cascade of scale-like green multichrome flakies and an alluring ambush of reflective glitter. it would turn even the most casual nailies clawnivorously ravenous. TYRANNOSAURUS HEX is a matte green lacquer filled with green multichrome flakies and jam-packed with reflective glitter. from the PRETTY PREHISTORIC SET . finish with a coat of MATTE MADE IN HELL to lock in your look, prolong your wear, + help this shade really pop. not a matte fan? just top this shade w SPEED DEMON TOP COAT for a glossy finish.

Name: Ultrahot
Description: a touch of solar flair. transform your look with this blazing hot mulitchrome lacquer, shifting between hot pink, orange, and yellow. ULTRAHOT is a multichrome lacquer that shifts between shades of hot pink, orange, and yellow as it’s viewed from different angles.

Name: Underdog
Description: NOT TO BE OVERLOOKED. UNDERDOG is a taupe creme lacquer. From the SUNDOG SET .

Name: Underworld Set
Description: TAKE THE PLUNGE. indulge in a few positively infernal delights. freshly plucked from the darkest depths of the invisible realm, comes 6 dreadfully divine new shimmers and flakies - some of the most devilishly shifty and sublimely glowy shades our galaxy has ever seen. unbottle the chaos and allow your claws to sink fully into the depths of each shade’s discordian mischief. the UNDERWORLD SET includes 6 special effect lacquers: HOUSE OF HADES , POMEGRANATE SEEDS , PANDEMONIUM , RIVER STYX , GATES OF HELL , and STOLEN AMBROSIA .

Name: Universe Essentials Duo
Description: ALL YOU NEED TO PREVENT GALACTIC INTERFERENCE. suit up, space traveler. prepare to explore all that the nail world has to offer. but first: minimize turbulence by always keeping these essentials on hand. keep your bases covered, by beginning every quest with a protective layer of our strengthening HARDCORE BASE COAT. and once you’re prepared to land, proactively avoid the universe’s many unforgiving dark forces, by finishing your mission with a glossy layer of our SPEED DEMON TOP COAT. the UNIVERSE ESSENTIALS DUO includes HARDCORE BASE COAT , our signature strengthening base coat, and SPEED DEMON TOP COAT , our glossy, quick-drying top coat.

Name: Vaporize
Description: leave those other lacquers in the dust. in a quick transfixing wave that shifts rapidly from g reen to orange to yellow , this malevolent multichrome will have a world-altering effect over you - before you even have time to realize it. VAPORIZE is a multichrome lacquer that shifts between shades of green, orange, and yellow as it’s viewed from different angles.

Name: Velociraptor
Description: WATCH YOUR TRACKS. there’s something glowing in the shadows. a fabled feathered foe. even now, fossilized in a mattified base, the sight of its camo-like dark teal silhouette is still delightfully frightful. it’s flocked with a deliberately disarming pop of orange-to-purple iridescent quills and emitting the aura of a thousand beady eyes slowly tracking your every move - thanks to its ambush of highly reflective glitter. it’ll make a most ferocious addition to any clawdrobe. VELOCIRAPTOR is a matte dark teal lacquer filled with color-shifting orange-to-purple iridescent flakies and reflective glitter. from the PRETTY PREHISTORIC SET . finish with a coat of MATTE MADE IN HELL to lock in your look, prolong your wear, + help this shade really pop. not a matte fan? just top this shade w SPEED DEMON TOP COAT for a glossy finish.

Name: Velvet Effect Horseshoe Magnet
Description: THE TOOL FOR THE EASIEST VELVET NAILS. the VELVET EFFECT HORSESHOE MAGNET is a high-strength, u-shaped magnet with a 30 lb. pull, designed exclusively for creating nail art with magnetic lacquer , like velvet nail designs. WATCH HOW TO USE + ADDITIONAL SAFETY TIPS IN THE VIDEO LINKED HERE. wear + care: features a strong, 30-pound magnetic pull ergonomic design makes magnetizing easier features a 23 mm opening for safety + to maintain magnet’s strength, always store with keeper base plate on always store away from magnetic lacquers + all other items sensitive to magnets we recommend you refrain from traveling with the magnet how to use: before use, remove the keeper base plate by pushing it off, NOT pulling it place finger inside of the magnet opening + paint your nail. hold until fully dry repeat with as many coats as desired then, repeat steps with your top coat, to lock in your look once done, to reattach the base plate, place the plate on a flat surface. hold horseshoe magnet by its rounded top edge, keeping fingers completely clear of the bottom. slowly lower magnet until the base plate reattaches. adjust, if needed safety warning: STRONG MAGNET: this is a professional-grade magnetic tool. please read before purchasing: keep away from children – not a toy. for external use only handle with care when removing the base plate to prevent pinching keep away from pacemakers, defibrillators, + medical implants keep away from credit cards, magnetic strips, + electronic devices intended for use with magnetic nail lacquer only always store away from other items sensitive to magnets use responsibly – avoid contact with sensitive items + never ingest. always adhere to safety guidelines. mooncat is not liable for injury or damage caused by misuse. by purchasing, you acknowledge that you understand the magnet’s strength + will use it only as intended. note: orders shipping to alaska, hawaii, or internationally are limited to one magnet per order, due to shipping restrictions.

Name: Velvet Rose
Description: RETRACT YOUR THORNS FOR A BIT. consider this velveteen bud a sign of our undying affection, and your invitation to experience the world through rose-colored claws. glittering with a pixie-like dash of holographic gold dust, this truly magnetizing tincture will lay a magical, petal-like trail of cascading silver-pink pigment wherever it goes. wield your wand any which way you please and watch as it endlessly blooms and blossoms into new favorite designs. VELVET ROSE is a dusty pink magnetic lacquer filled with gold micro holographic glitter that reveals a silver-pink magnetic stripe. this is CRYSTAL ROSE 2.0. note: all orders with magnetic lacquers include one free magnetic wand . WARNING: this product can expose you to chemicals including nickel, which is known to the state of california to cause cancer. for more information visit www.p65warnings.ca.gov

Name: Venus Flytrap
Description: HARDLY A SHRINKING VIOLET. this pretty flower is always ready to slowly devour those naive enough to dare underestimate it. fly too close to this magenta blossom and prepare to meet a holographic pang of its insatiable appetite. VENUS FLYTRAP is a magenta linear holographic lacquer. from the HEAVY IS THE CROWN collection. note: holographic lacquers look best in the sunlight or under a direct light, where they reveal their full rainbow effect. in the shade or overcast conditions, the effect will be more muted (but still mesmerizing).

Name: Warp Zone
Description: there’s always more to explore. open the gateway and unlock infinite pathways to explore – let this lime green linear holographic lacquer catapult you into the next stage. WARP ZONE is a lime green linear holographic lacquer. note: holographic lacquers look best in the sunlight or under a direct light, where they reveal their full rainbow effect. in the shade or overcast conditions, the effect will be more muted (but still mesmerizing).

Name: Weeping Willow
Description: SAD TREE CHIC. don’t keep your feelings bottled up. express yourself in all of your happysadsparkly glory with the help of this *truly* magnetic green tincture. with just the wave of your magnetic wand, you’ll be able to quickly morph this magical foliage-like green into endless engrossing designs, and send a cascade of dewey, reflective sparkles down your claws - like an avalanche mystical raindrops…or super-shiny teardrops. we’ll let you decide which. WEEPING WILLOW is an emerald green magnetic lacquer filled with reflective glitter that reveals a green stripe. from the LOST IN A FOLKTALE SET . note: for the sharpest cat eye, we recommend using your magnet over your nail after every coat (including your top coat).

Name: Welcome to Paradise
Description: SET IN A DESOLATE OASIS, IN A NEAR TOMORROW... the WELCOME TO PARADISE SET includes 10 nail lacquers: EPILOGUE TO UTOPIA , 404: SOUL NOT FOUND , PORT 6666 , MORAL DECAY , NIRVANA PRO X , EGO STROKER 9000 , MUTINY , MEOWTEK INDUSTRIES , CYBORG TEARS , and NIGHTMODE . all orders with magnetic lacquers include one free magnetic wand.

Name: Werewolf's Bane
Description: CHANNEL THE QUEEN OF ALL POISONS. WEREWOLF’S BANE is a deep purple holographic shimmer lacquer filled with blue shimmer. from the DEADLY BY NATURE SET .

Name: What Is My Purpose?
Description: trying to find your place in this expansive world? drop in and set your course. watch the world’s secrets reveal themselves in this bright violet linear holographic lacquer. WHAT IS MY PURPOSE? is a bright violet linear holographic lacquer. note: holographic lacquers look best in the sunlight or under a direct light, where they reveal their full rainbow effect. in the shade or overcast conditions, the effect will be more muted (but still mesmerizing).

Name: When The Devil Strikes
Description: LIKE LIGHTNING IN A BOTTLE. from the dust of broken halos, comes a truly electrifying matte shade. you never know when sudden bursts of golden flakes may strike against its gloom-filled, black-cloud-like matte backdrop…so saddle up, and take your claws for a wild, wild ride. WHEN THE DEVIL STRIKES is a matte black lacquer filled with golden flakies. from the MIDNIGHT RODEO SET . finish with a coat of MATTE MADE IN HELL to lock in your look, prolong your wear, + help this shade really pop. not a matte fan? just top this shade w SPEED DEMON TOP COAT for a glossy finish.

Name: Whiskered Willows
Description: TAKE A TRIP THROUGH AN OTHERWORLDLY FOREST… WHISKERED WILLOWS is a lavender glitter lacquer jam-packed with multicolor reflective and holographic glitter. From the PLANET NYARR SET . Wear + Care: Due to the highly-pigmented nature of this lacquer, its consistency will gradually grow thicker over time. Simply add a few drops of LACQUER REVITALIZER , to revive its consistency How to use: For maximum opacity, use multiple short, dab-like brush strokes per coat. Allow it to dry fully between coats. This lacquer will dry textured. Top with SPEED DEMON TOP COAT for a smooth, glossy finish. Holographic flare appears in sunlight or direct light Reflective sparkle appears under camera/phone flash + very bright direct light

Name: Whiskey Sunrise
Description: POUR YOUR HEART OUT. treat your claws to a warm-colored cocktail that’s as sweet as strawberry wine. this terracotta red multichrome shimmer shifts through sun drenched shades of orange, red, and green that’ll have you feeling like you’re perched on a summer storm cloud overlooking the setting moon. WHISKEY SUNRISE is a warm terracotta red multichrome shimmer lacquer that shifts between shades of orange, red, and green as it’s viewed from different angles. from the MIDNIGHT RODEO SET .

Name: White Rabbit
Description: TRAVEL THROUGH THE LOOKING GLASS. consider this an opaque white canvas for you to project your innermost nonsense.where down is up and right is left and nothing is what it is because it’s precisely what it isn't. WHITE RABBIT is a highly opaque white creme lacquer. from the TECHNICOLOR DREAMS collection.

Name: Winds of Fate
Description: ever shifting and changing on a whim this luminous lilac blush lacquer shimmers brightly in the face of all that is yet to come. WINDS OF FATE is a lilac blush lacquer filled with yellow, green, and red shimmer.

Name: Wishbone
Description: DOG’S BEST FRIEND. WISHBONE is an ivory creme lacquer. From the SUNDOG SET .

Name: Witch Hazel
Description: A REMEDY FOR ALL SEASONS. some may call this forever form-shifting peach-yellow shimmer “pure witchcraft.” and with this endlessly-shifty tincture’s ability to distract from nearly any affliction, that might not be far off. cursed with claw blah-ness? in need of inspiration? as it soothingly shimmers between golden and peach and subtly green hues, this otherworldly yellow has been known to instantly mellow any everyday woes brave enough to cross its path. WITCH HAZEL is a peach yellow shimmer lacquer that color-shifts between shades of peachy-pink, yellow, and green. from the FALLEN SET .

Name: Witching Hour Set
Description: WELCOME TO YOUR SECRET COVEN. these four linear holographic lacquers unite their reality-bending powers in one bewitching, must-have set. with every brushstroke, you’ll cast a hypnotizing spell over your claws and unleash the inescapable magic of their charms . . . the WITCHING HOUR SET includes four linear holographic lacquers: CRUEL MIRAGE , a black linear holo, BOA CONSTRICTOR , a chocolate linear holo, FAKE HALO , a rose gold linear holo, and BLOOD MOON , a black linear holo with red shimmer. note: holographic lacquers look best in the sunlight or under a direct light, where they reveal their full rainbow effect. in the shade or overcast conditions, the effect will be more muted (but still mesmerizing).

Name: Your Heart’s A Black Hole
Description: WEAR YOUR FEELINGS ON YOUR SLEEVE. an ode to the morose, the melancholic, the mysterious, this suitably moody dark red magnetic lacquer will help you bask in your broodiest of musings. with a wave of your magnetic wand, this vampy and versatile tincture - twinkling with a stellar touch of micro holo glitter - will eb and flow with the gravitational pull of your ever-shifting mood, quickly warping into a sharp red cat eye, a supermassive wave of soft red velvet, or any magnetic design in between. YOUR HEART’S A BLACK HOLE is a deep red magnetic lacquer filled with micro holo glitter that reveals a light red magnetic stripe.
